job.title: Locum Clinical Pharmacist
job.description:
• October – February – flexible duration
  • Ward based clinical pharmacy
  • Upto $90 per hour + travel + accomm

Experienced Clinical Pharmacists required for locum based in regional Victoria, 5 hours from Melbourne. This is a large regional hospital. You will become part of a great allied health team. You will work across the wards to cover:


  • General acute inpatients including neurology, general medical, orthopaedics, surgical and rehab, ED and ICU
  • Full time hours, Monday – Friday
  • FREE accommodation available – my current locums are in individual apartments
  • Domestic travel reimbursed
  • Locum rates dependent on experience, upto $75 per hour + super + option for living away from home tax benefits – $6-$7 per hour more!
  • Upto $90 ABN per hour
  • October – February – flexible duration based on your availability
  • I’ve had great feedback from current locums. Many choose to stay on or return to the service
  • Australian hospital ward experience is mandatory
 
This major regional centre offers a vibrant culture filled with city sidewalk cafes and precincts of contemporary restaurants constantly surprise dedicated foodies with their innovative fare, fresh local produce. Enjoy local vineyards, a great climate and fun on the banks of the Murray River.

 
Working in regional Australia offers the chance to work within close knit communities. As part of smaller teams, you will access a wider range of patients and develop your clinical expertise. These roles offer great rates of pay, accommodation and the chance to broaden your skill set within a range of healthcare settings.
 


To apply for this role or to enquire about our other vacancies, please contact Rachael – Allied Health Division Lead at CC Medical on 0452 189 556 or email rachaeld@ccjobs.com.au



My contactable hours are Monday – Friday. If you need to contact me over the weekend, please send an email.

 
Register today for information on all of our vacancies.

 
View all our vacancies here: www.ccjobs.com.au

job.title: Consultant Emergency Medicine
job.description:
Consultant Emergency Medicine Leadership opportunities | Coastal Western Australia
Remuneration package: $424,525–$539,140 per annum
Additional Head of Department allowance: $19,174 per annum, where applicable

Build your specialist career by the coast, with opportunities to lead, teach and shape a regional Emergency Medicine service.

CC Medical is seeking Consultant Emergency Physicians to join an established regional referral hospital in Western Australia’s Midwest. Opportunities are available to undertake Head of Department responsibilities or pursue a Director of Emergency Medicine Training pathway.

Permanent, fixed-term, full-time, part-time and sessional appointments are available, with flexible working arrangements and fractional FTE encouraged.
The opportunity Join a busy Emergency Department delivering specialist care across a diverse range of acute, trauma and critical care presentations. You will lead clinical decision-making, support junior doctors and assist surrounding regional hospitals through telehealth and retrieval coordination.

Recent infrastructure investment includes a contemporary, purpose-built Emergency Department, a new Intensive Care Unit and a Mental Health Inpatient Unit. Emergency facilities include:
  • Four resuscitation bays.
  • Fast Track and Ambulatory Care areas.
  • A Short Stay Unit.
  • Low-stimulus observation facilities.
  • Dedicated procedure and plaster rooms.

Work alongside an experienced multidisciplinary team, supported by 24/7 senior medical presence, within an ACEM, RACGP and ACRRM accredited training environment.
Leadership and professional development Make a meaningful contribution to clinical education, workforce development and service improvement.

Experienced consultants can influence departmental direction through Head of Department duties, while clinicians with a strong interest in teaching may be considered for a Director of Emergency Medicine Training pathway.
Enjoy coastal living Finish your shift by the beach and spend your weekends exploring the coastline, boating, fishing or enjoying spectacular sunsets over the Indian Ocean.

This vibrant regional city combines beautiful beaches, waterfront cafés and restaurants with the convenience of a regional centre. Enjoy a welcoming community and a relaxed outdoor lifestyle, with plenty of opportunities to explore Western Australia’s coast and outback.

Benefits
  • Annual remuneration package of $424,525–$539,140.
  • Additional Head of Department allowance of $19,174 per annum, where applicable.
  • Sessional remuneration of $817.44–$1,038.13 per session.
  • Regional incentives, relocation support and accommodation assistance.
  • Flexible working arrangements, including part-time and fractional FTE.
  • Four weeks’ annual leave plus three weeks’ professional development leave.
  • Five weeks’ overseas professional development leave after five years.
  • Opportunities in leadership, education and service development.

About you You will hold FACEM or an equivalent specialist qualification, with unrestricted specialist registration in Emergency Medicine with the Medical Board of Australia.

You will also bring:
  • Senior Emergency Medicine experience within Australian healthcare settings.
  • Strong resuscitation and procedural skills.
  • Confidence managing complex presentations where subspecialty support may be limited.
  • Sound clinical judgement and a collaborative approach to leadership.
  • A commitment to teaching, mentoring and high-quality patient care.

Experience in rural emergency medicine, retrieval medicine, critical care or regional referral services will be highly regarded.

Find out more Ready to explore your next career move?

Contact Nicki Wade for a confidential discussion.

Nicki Wade
Senior Medical Recruitment Consultant
Phone: +61 401 010 048
Email: nickiw@ccjobs.com.au

CC Medical — over 30 years of recruitment expertise, formerly known as Careers Connection.

job.title: Locum Hospital Dietitian
job.description:
• ASAP start for three weeks
  • Upto $75 per hour + super
  • Acute caseload
 
Experienced Hospital Dietitian required for urgent locum in Brisbane, Queensland. The role is to start ASAP for three weeks.
  • Acute inpatient caseload, across the wards
  • You will work in a hospital setting and must have Australian hospital experience
  • Locum rates up to $75 + super depending on experience
  • No accommodation or travel provided
  • You must have APD status before you apply
 
This hospital is located in the inner northern suburbs of Brisbane.
 
 
To apply for this role or to enquire about our other vacancies, please contact Rachael – Allied Health Division Lead at CC Medical on 0452 189 556 or email rachaeld@ccjobs.com.au

 
My contactable days are Monday – Friday. If you need to contact me over the weekend, please send an email.

 
Register today for information on all of our vacancies.
 
View all our vacancies here: www.ccjobs.com.au

job.title: Registered Nurse - Skin Cancer Nurse
job.description:
Skin Cancer Nurse (Registered Nurse)

Role Overview

Want to be part of a big national program that screens people for skin cancer at work? We're looking for nurses to join our team in cities like Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, and more. You can work on a casual or contract basis, and we have jobs in both cities and rural areas. As a skin cancer nurse, you'll assess people's skin and moles, use special tools for a closer look, and figure out if anyone needs to see a doctor. You'll also keep track of everything in our records. It's a excellent way to help people stay healthy and catch any problems early.

Skills & Experience
  • Current AHPRA Registered Nurse registration
  • Experience in skin cancer screening, skin checks or mole checks
  • Strong clinical assessment and communication skills
  • Ability to work independently and manage onsite screening sessions
  • Skin cancer/dermoscopy qualifications 
  • Mole mapping/melanography experience and own dermoscope advantageous
Benefits & Perks
  • Flexible casual & contract opportunities
  • Competitive compensation based on experience and qualifications
  • National, with potential regional and rural opportunities
  • Travel and other allowances where applicable
  • Training provided on relevant systems and processes
  • Ongoing opportunities within a growing national program
Referral reward

Introduce a Skin Cancer Nurse and receive a $750 incentive from us once eligibility conditions are met (T&Cs apply). Refer a Colleague| Healthcare Professionals 

About us

We are a boutique Healthcare recruitment agency with 30+ years’ experience connecting healthcare professionals to meaningful roles across Australia.

How to apply

If you're interested in this job, you can apply on SEEK or contact our team to discuss. And don't worry if this one isn't exactly what you're looking for - we have lots of other jobs available that might be a better suited for your skills.

job.title: Locum Podiatrist/Senior Podiatrist
job.description:
• ASAP start for three months ++ (shorter term by negotiation)
  • Outpatients, high risk feet, complex wound care
  • Locum rates & FREE accommodation + travel

 
Experienced Podiatrists required for role with regional health service, located approximately four hours from Adelaide. You’ll join a medium size allied health team. The role is to start ASAP for three months ++ in duration.
 
There are several vacancies across two locations. Open to AHP 1, 2 or 3 level options.
 
 
Your caseload will cover:
  • Rural generalist caseload. Caseload is predominately outpatients, but includes some inpatients, aged care and paediatrics. May be opportunities for outreach to rural/ remote communities. Caseload would be allocated as per experience.
  • You will be will be proficient in high risk wound care (with 30-40 active high-risk wound patients at the site) but would be working in a rural generalist role servicing clients across the age spectrum and across clinical priorities and programs.
  • Regional/ rural experience preferred - working with Aboriginal consumers, high risk wound experience.
  • Join a multi-disciplinary team including OT, PT, SP, SW, O&P, DT. The Podiatrists work closely with Diabetes Educators, Orthotics & Prosthetics and Wound Nurse. The Podiatry department will soon consistent of 3 contractor/ FIFO staff.
  • You will be working in the local community. A car is provided for work purposes. The role will be Monday – Friday, 37.5 hours per week.
  • Free accommodation provided
  • Upto $500 reimbursed for travel (with receipts)
  • Competitive locum rates in line with experience – PAYG + option for living away from home tax benefits or ABN (up to $100 per hour)
 
I’ve placed many locums with this service over the years and the feedback is positive. The team are young and inclusive.
 
 
Located on Eyre Peninsula’s Spencer Gulf in South Australia, this region is an important hub and the region’s biggest city for retail shopping. The location boasts a warm climate, accessible ocean shores and saltwater fishing. It represents South Australia’s foremost combination of industrial and nature-based experiences. With vivid scenery, small city charm, distinctive mystic outback landscapes and year-round things to do.
 


To apply for this role or to enquire about our other vacancies, please contact Rachael – Allied Health Division Lead at CC Medical on 0452 189 556 or email rachaeld@ccjobs.com.au

 
My contactable days are Monday – Friday. If you need to contact me over the weekend, please send an email.

job.title: Registered Nurse - Skin Cancer Nurse
job.description:
Skin Cancer Nurse (Registered Nurse)

Role Overview

Want to be part of a big national program that screens people for skin cancer at work? We're looking for nurses to join our team in cities like Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, and more. You can work on a casual or contract basis, and we have jobs in both cities and rural areas. As a skin cancer nurse, you'll assess people's skin and moles, use special tools for a closer look, and figure out if anyone needs to see a doctor. You'll also keep track of everything in our records. It's a excellent way to help people stay healthy and catch any problems early.

Skills & Experience
  • Current AHPRA Registered Nurse registration
  • Experience in skin cancer screening, skin checks or mole checks
  • Strong clinical assessment and communication skills
  • Ability to work independently and manage onsite screening sessions
  • Skin cancer/dermoscopy qualifications highly desirable
  • Mole mapping/melanography experience and own dermoscope advantageous
Benefits & Perks
  • Flexible casual & contract opportunities
  • Competitive compensation based on experience and qualifications
  • National, regional and rural opportunities
  • Travel and other allowances where applicable
  • Training provided on relevant systems and processes
  • Ongoing opportunities within a growing national program
Referral reward

Introduce a Skin Cancer Nurse and receive a $750 incentive from us once eligibility conditions are met (T&Cs apply). Refer a Colleague | Healthcare Professionals 

About us

We are a boutique Healthcare recruitment agency with 30+ years’ experience connecting healthcare professionals to meaningful roles across Australia.

How to apply

If you're interested in this job, you can apply on SEEK or contact our team to discuss. And don't worry if this one isn't exactly what you're looking for - we have lots of other jobs available that might be a better suited for your skills.

job.title: Locum Podiatrists required!
job.description:
Locum Podiatrists required for locums across Australia.

  • Locum rates upto $100 ABN per hour. PAYG also an option
  • Accommodation provided
  • Travel reimbursment

Please see below for our latest vacancies:


Regional South Australia - 2 x Locum Podiatrist/Senior Podiatrist
  • Flexible start date for 3 months
  • Outpatients, high risk feet, complex wound care
  • Locum rates & FREE accommodation + travel
 
Experienced Podiatrists required for role with regional health service, located approximately four hours from Adelaide. You’ll join a medium size allied health team. Three months ++ in duration. Shorter term by negotiation.
 
There are several vacancies across two locations. Open to AHP 1, 2 or 3 level options.
 
Your caseload will cover:
  • Rural generalist caseload. Caseload is predominately outpatients, but includes some inpatients, aged care and paediatrics. May be opportunities for outreach to rural/ remote communities. Caseload would be allocated as per experience.
  • You will be will be proficient in high risk wound care (with 30-40 active high-risk wound patients at the site) but would be working in a rural generalist role servicing clients across the age spectrum and across clinical priorities and programs.
  • Regional/ rural experience preferred - working with Aboriginal consumers, high risk wound experience.
  • Join a multi-disciplinary team including OT, PT, SP, SW, O&P, DT. The Podiatrists work closely with Diabetes Educators, Orthotics & Prosthetics and Wound Nurse. The Podiatry department will soon consistent of 3 contractor/ FIFO staff.
  • You will be working in the local community. A car is provided for work purposes. The role will be Monday – Friday, 37.5 hours per week.
  • Free accommodation provided
  • Upto $500 reimbursed for travel (with receipts)
  • Competitive locum rates in line with experience – PAYG + option for living away from home tax benefits or ABN (up to $100 per hour)
 
I’ve placed many locums with this service over the years and the feedback is positive. The team are young and inclusive.
 
 
Located on Eyre Peninsula’s Spencer Gulf in South Australia, this region is an important hub and the region’s biggest city for retail shopping. The location boasts a warm climate, accessible ocean shores and saltwater fishing. It represents South Australia’s foremost combination of industrial and nature-based experiences. With vivid scenery, small city charm, distinctive mystic outback landscapes and year-round things to do.
 
 
 
 
2.5 hours from Melbourne - Locum Hospital Podiatrist – my favourite service
  • ASAP start date for 3-6 months
  • Locum rates + FREE accommodation
  • Gorgeous VIC tourist hotspot!
Join this lovely regional health service based in Victoria, 2.5 hours from Melbourne. A great team, my other locums have loved this service. This caseload will cover:
  • Low to high risk, mostly CHSP (aged care), and small amount of CHMDS (community health) – all based out of the community health centre
  • You must have wound care / high risk foot experience
  • Preferably someone with at least 2 years hospital experience
  • I’ve worked with this service for many years and had great feedback!
  • ASAP start date for 3-6 months
  • Locum rates based on experience
  • Potential for living away from home tax benefits (more take home pay, up to $6 dollars more an hour!)
  • ABN payments are also an option
  • Onsite accommodation available
 
I’ve had great feedback from other locums, who have really enjoyed their time with the service.
 
Gorgeous VIC location, which is a popular tourist hot spot! I’ve worked with this service for years and it is fabulous!
 
 
 
 

SA - Home of the Great White Shark Dive - Locum Podiatrist - ASAP start for 8-12 weeks 
  • ASAP start for 12 weeks ++
  • Outpatients, high risk feet, complex wound care
  • Locum rates & FREE accommodation + travel
Experienced Podiatrists required for role with regional health service, located approximately seven hours drive from Adelaide (there is an airport in town). You’ll join a medium size allied health team. The role is to start ASAP. 8-12 weeks  ++ in duration.
 
 
Your caseload will cover:
  • Rural generalist caseload. Caseload is predominately outpatients, but includes some inpatients, aged care and paediatrics. May be opportunities for outreach to rural/ remote communities. Caseload would be allocated as per experience.
  • You will be proficient in high risk wound care but would be working in a rural generalist role servicing clients across the age spectrum and across clinical priorities and programs.
  • Regional/ rural experience preferred - working with Aboriginal consumers, high risk wound experience.
  • Sunrise experience preferred for clinical documentation needs
  • You will be working in the local community. A car is provided for work purposes. The role will be Monday – Friday, 37.5 hours per week.
  • Free accommodation provided
  • Competitive locum rates in line with experience – PAYG + option for living away from home tax benefits or ABN (up to $100 per hour)
 
The Eyre and Far North covers almost 440,000 square kilometres of spectacular South Australia, supporting about 40,000 people living around Eyre Peninsula and the Far North of the state.
 
With its ancient outback landscapes and culture, boutique vineyards, renowned oyster farms and Australia’s best-kept-secret surf coast, the Eyre Peninsula and Far North offers a lifestyle that will inspire and energise you. The region enjoys a Mediterranean style climate so there’s plenty of opportunity to enjoy everything the region has to offer. From surfing and fishing to hiking and exploring the outback – create your best life, right here.
 
 
 
 
 
URGENT Regional VIC - Podiatrist – regional health service - ASAP start date
  • Rural Generalist inc:  outpatients & community
  • Travel + accommodation available
  • Locum rates up to $85 PAYG/$100 ABN
Experienced Podiatrist required for locum based in regional Victoria. The role is to start 31st August (or ASAP), flexible duration for locums - minimum 8 weeks required.
  • You will work alongside a small allied health team. This generalist caseload will cover:
  • A mixed caseload of clients from 0-100 years
  • Working across outpatients, community, a small amount of aged care & outreach
  • You will work alongside a team of other allied health professionals on the team including OT, Physiotherapist, Exercise Physiologist, Speech Pathologists, Dietitian, Qualified Social Worker, Health Promotion Officer and Allied Health Assistants
 
FREE accommodation available and locum rates up to $85 + super PAYG/$100 ABN. Travel reimbursement also available.
 
I’ve had great feedback from previous locums! There is also a permanent opportunity available. Minimum one year experience required.
 
 
 
 
 
Townsville, sunny QLD - Locum Podiatrist
  • ASAP start for 4-12 weeks + possible extension
  • Locum rates $$ + car provided
  • Community and outreach
Locum Podiatrist required for a role in sunny Townsville. I’ve had great feedback from other locums. You will join a team of allied health clinicians.
 
  • The caseload is generalist position covering outreach communities of Charters Towers, Collinsville, Bowen, Ayr/Home Hill, Ingham
  • Predominantly working with community-based aged care clients- no nursing homes; diabetes foot assessments, primary care
  • Monday – Friday. The hours are flexible to account for time spent travelling to outreach sites.
  • No accommodation available
  • All travel amongst sites covered using fleet cars
 
Additional Information:
  • ASAP for 4-12 weeks + longer term options also available.
  • Locum rates based on experience, more for ABN!
  • Potential for PAYG living away from home benefits (more take home pay, usually $5-7 dollars more an hour!).
A car is provided for work travel between sites.
 
Escape winter in sunny Townsville. Enjoy a tropical climate, thriving water sports scene including diving, snorkelling, boating, fishing, kayaking. Explore the neighbouring islands and Great Barrier Reef, enjoy endless sunshine, national parks, hikes and waterfalls and a bustling city centre.
 
 
 
 
 
Remote QLD - 2 x Locum Podiatrist – remote health and outreach
  • ASAP start for 8-12 weeks + possible extension
  • Locum rates $$ + accommodation and travel provided
  • Community and outreach
2 x Locum Podiatrists required for locum roles in Outback Queensland. I’ve had great feedback from other locums. You will join a team of allied health clinicians and cover:
  • Initial assessments and reviews
  • Diabetic foot assessments
  • General nail care and treatment
  • Biomechanical and orthotics
  • A generalist caseload predominantly for low to moderate risk clients
  • Outreach involving road and sometimes aircraft with overnight travel. The multidisciplinary team provides outreach to communities in the area
  • Indigenous and Torres Strait Islander population as well as general population
  • Monday – Friday. The hours are flexible to account for time spent travelling to outreach sites.
  • There are two locations available.
 
 
Additional Information:
  • ASAP for 8-12 weeks + longer term options also available.
  • Locum rates based on experience, more for ABN.
  • Potential for PAYG living away from home benefits (more take home pay, usually $5-7 dollars more an hour!).
  • FREE accommodation, a private room in a share house. There may or may not be other occupants depending on timing. A car is also provided for local use.
  • Return flights reimbursed.
  • Are you ready to experience Outback Australia?
 
 
 
 
Working in regional Australia offers the chance to work within close knit communities. As part of smaller teams, you will access a wider range of patients and develop your clinical expertise. These roles offer great rates of pay, accommodation and the chance to broaden your skill set within a range of healthcare settings.

job.title: Consultant/Specialist Anaesthetists – Multiple Australian Locations
job.description:
Consultant/Specialist Anaesthetists – Multiple Australian Locations
Permanent | Fixed term | Staff Specialist | Senior Staff Specialist | VMO opportunities

Are you a qualified Anaesthetist considering your next career move?

CC Medical is recruiting for a range of Consultant Anaesthetist positions across regional, coastal and tropical Australia. Opportunities are available for experienced FANZCAs, specialists approaching Fellowship and suitably qualified international specialists who have been assessed as substantially comparable or are eligible via the expedited pathway.

Choose the lifestyle that suits you
Coastal Queensland
Enjoy warm weather, beautiful beaches, affordable coastal living and a relaxed family-friendly lifestyle. These expanding regional services offer broad clinical exposure, flexible working arrangements and attractive remuneration packages.

Coastal New South Wales
Build your career in a welcoming regional community surrounded by beaches, rivers, national parks and picturesque hinterland. Enjoy an affordable lifestyle, excellent schools and convenient access to major metropolitan centres.

Tropical Northern Australia
Experience an adventurous outdoor lifestyle with warm weather, spectacular national parks, fishing, boating and easy access to Southeast Asia. These roles offer diverse clinical experience across anaesthesia, acute pain and perioperative medicine, together with generous professional development and leave benefits.

Metropolitan New South Wales
Maintain the convenience of city living while working within busy tertiary and teaching environments. Current opportunities provide exposure to high-acuity and complex caseloads within culturally diverse communities.

Regional Victoria
Enjoy an affordable regional lifestyle within easy reach of mountains, lakes, beaches and wineries. Join a growing health service offering varied clinical practice, strong multidisciplinary support and convenient access to Melbourne.

Current opportunities include
  • Senior Specialist and Specialist appointments
  • Consultant and Specialist Anaesthetist positions
  • Senior Medical Officer opportunities
  • Permanent full-time and part-time roles
  • Fixed-term contracts
  • Visiting Medical Officer appointments
  • Flexible rostering and private-practice opportunities
  • Teaching, supervision and clinical leadership responsibilities
  • Professional development allowances and leave
  • Relocation and immigration assistance for eligible candidates
Essential requirements
Applicants should hold, or be eligible for:
  • Specialist registration with AHPRA
  • Fellowship of ANZCA or an equivalent international specialist qualification
  • Assessment through the ANZCA Specialist International Medical Graduate pathway, where applicable
  • Appropriate Australian working rights or eligibility for employer-sponsored immigration

Where could your next career move take you?
Whether you’re drawn to coastal living, a tropical adventure or the opportunities of a metropolitan service, we’d love to help you find a role that aligns with your career goals and preferred lifestyle.

For a confidential discussion about current opportunities, locations and your specialist pathway, please contact:
Nicki Wade
Senior Recruitment Consultant – Permanent Doctors
CC Medical

job.title: Consultant Psychiatrist – Adult and Older Persons Mental Health
job.description:
Consultant Psychiatrist – Adult and Older Persons Mental Health
Coastal, Regional Victoria
Permanent full-time | 76 hours per fortnight
Salary package up to $450k+
IMGs – assessed as substantially comparable or eligible via expedited pathway will be considered.

An excellent opportunity is available for a Consultant Psychiatrist to join a supportive and expanding Adult Mental Health and Wellbeing Service in one of regional Victoria’s most attractive coastal locations.

An exceptional coastal lifestyle
Located along Victoria’s spectacular south-west coast, the region offers the ideal combination of professional opportunity, affordability and work-life balance.

You can enjoy:
  • Beautiful beaches and dramatic coastal scenery
  • Easy access to the Great Ocean Road and nearby historic seaside villages
  • Surfing, swimming, fishing, kayaking, scuba diving and boating
  • Excellent public and private schools
  • A welcoming, family-friendly community
  • A thriving café, restaurant, arts and cultural scene
  • Music, food and community festivals throughout the year
  • Affordable housing compared with metropolitan areas
  • Shorter commutes and more time to enjoy life outside work
  • Convenient road and rail connections to Melbourne
Whether you are looking to raise a family, enjoy an active coastal lifestyle or escape the congestion and cost of a major city, this region offers an enviable place to live and work.

The opportunity
Working across community and inpatient services, you will provide high-quality psychiatric assessment and treatment to adults and older people experiencing a broad range of mental health conditions.
You will provide clinical leadership and governance to a multidisciplinary case-management team, helping consumers navigate a coordinated and recovery-focused journey through the service.

The clinical component of the position is predominant, with additional opportunities to contribute to education, leadership and the continuing development of regional mental health services.
This is an exciting time to join the service, with the Adult/Older Persons Mental Health Unit undergoing a significant $10.9 million redevelopment to provide modern facilities for consumers and staff.

To be considered, you will have:
  • Fellowship of the Royal Australian and New Zealand College of Psychiatrists, or an equivalent specialist qualification – IMGs eligible via expedited pathway or assessed as substantially comparable.
  • Current CPD compliance
  • Experience in Older Persons Psychiatry across inpatient and community services
  • Strong multidisciplinary teamwork, communication and time-management skills
  • Ability to supervise and work collaboratively with other clinicians
  • Competence using electronic medical records
Advanced training in Adult or Old Age Psychiatry is desirable but not essential.

Benefits
The successful applicant will receive:
  • An attractive specialist remuneration package
  • Permanent full-time employment
  • Salary packaging for meals and entertainment
  • Novated leasing and additional superannuation contribution options
  • Internal and external professional development opportunities
  • Ongoing clinical supervision and peer support
  • Leadership, resilience and mentoring programs
  • Opportunities to contribute to service development, education and research
  • Excellent employment terms and conditions
Join a progressive regional mental health service where your expertise, leadership and contribution will be genuinely valued.

Ready to make your next career move?
If you’re looking for a rewarding specialist role and an exceptional coastal lifestyle, we’d love to hear from you.

To express your interest or learn more about this opportunity, please contact Nicki Wade for a confidential discussion.

job.title: Locum Clinical Pharmacists required!
job.description:
Locum Clinical Pharmacists required for locums across Australia.

  • Locum rates upto $100 ABN per hour. PAYG also an option
  • Accommodation provided
  • Travel reimbursement

Please see below for our latest vacancies:

 
Northern Territory – Locum Hospital Pharmacist – 3-4 day locums
  • Return travel & accommodation provided
  • Locum rates upto $75 per hour + super – more for ABN
  • Join my other locums!
Experienced Hospital Pharmacist required for this Northern Territory hospital. You will join a team of allied health clinicians. Join my other locums!
 
The Pharmacy use Merlin Dispensing Software and will be based on one general medicine ward. The team comprises of a Pharmacy Manager, one Clinical Pharmacist and one Pharmacy Technician. The hours of work per day are 8am to 4:21pm, Monday – Friday.
 
The following dates are available:
  • 20/10/2026 to 23/10/2026
  • 2/11/2026 to 6/11/2026
Further details:
  • Return travel reimbursement capped at $1,200
  • Upto $75 per hour + super + potential for living away from home benefits (more take home pay, usually $5-6 dollars more an hour!)
  • More for ABN holders
  • Accommodation provided
  • Join my other locums who LOVE this service!
 
 
 
 
Northern Rivers, NSW - Locum Clinical Pharmacists required - families welcome!
  • ASAP start for 13 weeks (or less if preferred)
  • Locum rates + travel + accommodation
  • Gorgeous NSW location!
Experienced Clinical Pharmacists required for locums in gorgeous Northern Rivers, NSW. To be considered you will be a clinical hospital pharmacist experience that is comfortable covering ICU, CCU, General Medical, Surgical, O&G, Emergency.


You must have Australian hospital experience.
  • ASAP start for 13 weeks (or less if preferred)
  • The hours of work are 8am-4:30pm Monday – Friday
  • The facility is a level 3 /4 hospital
  • EMR/Ipharmacy experience preferred
  • Accommodation can be provided – families welcome
  • Travel reimbursed
  • Locum rates up to $80 per hour depending on experience + superannuation, up to $100 for ABN
  • Option for PAYG living away from home tax benefits ($7/8 dollars per hour more).
 
This regional city is the gateway to the wild rivers, ravishing gorges and ancient rainforest of nearby National Park. Here, forest-clad escarpments create a striking backdrop for paddling, hiking, camping and 4WD touring. Enjoy white water rafting, canoeing and river tubing tours or you can take a multi-day camping river tour or hire canoes. The location also has a rich history and a thriving food scene.
 
 
 
  
 
Northern NSW - Locum Hospital Pharmacists required - flexible duration
  • ASAP start for 8 weeks
  • Accommodation provided
  • Locum rates + accommodation
Experienced Hospital Pharmacists required for locums in gorgeous Northern NSW – driving distance to Byron Bay. To be considered you will be a clinical hospital pharmacist experience that is comfortable covering general medical, surgical and / or oncology & haematology inpatient wards. 
 
You must have Australian hospital experience.
  • ASAP for 8 weeks.
  • Locum available until December.
  • Accommodation can be provided.
  • Locum rates up to $80 per hour depending on experience + superannuation, up to $100 for ABN
  • Option for PAYG living away from home tax benefits ($7/8 dollars per hour more).
 
Great feedback from other locums!
 
This large regional city is close to the iconic Byron Bay, Bangalow, Mullumbimby. Enjoy the summer months in this gorgeous part of New South Wales.
 
 
 
 
 
Coastal QLD – Locum Clinical Pharmacist
  • Flexible start dates
  • Accommodation + travel assistance
  • Upto $90 per hour ABN
Minimum duration of 8 weeks required.
 
Further details:
  • The service use IPharmacy
  • Upto $70 per hour + super depending on experience + option for PAYG living away from home tax benefits, upto $6 per hour more in your take home pay
  • Upto $90 per hour under ABN
  • Accommodation provided or accommodation allowance of upto $90 per night
  • Upto $250 each way reimbursed for travel
  • There will be credentialing paperwork to complete before you can commence
  • You must have AHPRA registration and Australian hospital pharmacy experience
  • Great feedback from current locums!
 
This location is a tourist hotspot, famed for whale watching, water sports, iconic beaches and islands. It’s within driving distance of Brisbane and the Sunshine Coast. I’ve placed many locums with this service and the feedback is excellent.
 
 

 
 
NW TAS - Locum Hospital Pharmacist required
  • Flexible start for up to three months
  • Accommodation assistance
  • Ward or dispensary
New locum role available in North West Tasmania. The start date is flexible for upto three months. You will be either ward or dispensary based.
 
You will work as a part of the relevant Hospital’s Pharmacy Department and Hospital’s Pharmacy Team to provide a comprehensive, efficient and accountable pharmacy service for hospital inpatients and outpatients.
  • Locum rates upto $75 per hour, dependent on experience + there is potential for living away from home tax benefits (more take home pay, up to $6 dollars more an hour!)
  • Upto $90 per hour for ABN holders
  • Accommodation available
This location has it all. Gorgeous natural surroundings, captivating history, rugged mountains, award winning restaurants, infamous art galleries, waterfront views and popular weekend markets. A great place to spend a few months!
 
 
 
 
 
Darwin, NT - Locum Hospital Pharmacist  
  • 8 weeks in duration
  • Upto $75 per hour + super, more for ABN
  • Accommodation + travel assistance
Experienced Hospital Pharmacists required for urgent locums in Darwin.  This is an acute hospital. The caseload will cover ward based across medical, surgical, renal, cardiology. You must be confident working across the wards.
 
Further details:
  • Hours/days per week – 5 days per week, 7.21 hours per day (36.45 hours/week)
  • The work will span dispensary, discharge and admissions teams. Inpatients across all areas of the hospital, including medical, surgical, renal, cardiology.
  • Join a team of 30 pharmacists
  • Accommodation is onsite and is charged at a cost of $155 per week (first 2 weeks waived)
  • Return travel allowance is up to $600 (with receipts)
  • You must have AHPRA registration and Australian hospital pharmacy experience
 
The Northern Territory is a multi-cultural region with lots to offer including great markets, restaurants, nightlife and natural beauty. Explore the iconic Kakadu and Litchfield National Park, as well as the Tiwi Islands and enjoy cheap flights to Bali.
 
 
 
 
NT – Locum Hospital Pharmacist
  • ASAP start date for 8 weeks + possible extension
  • Several vacancies available
  • Standard work hours are 8am- 4:21 pm with a 1 hr unpaid lunch break Monday to Friday
  • Dispensary or clinical ward depending on experience
  • Subsidised accommodation available
  • Upto $1000 towards return travel
  • Locum rates based on experience + living away from home allowances – more take home pay!
 
Join this large allied health team, including some of my other locums. All have extended their time with this hospital. The team are inclusive and social. There is support and supervision available.
85% of the caseload is indigenous, with 50% coming in from remote communities. I’ve had great feedback from my current locums and this is a great chance to develop your skill set. If you like the outdoors, the lifestyle here is fab!
 
The location is a great base for exploring the natural wonders of the Outback including: Uluru, Kata Tjuta, Kings Canyon, the West MacDonnell Ranges and the Larapinta Trail, the Simpson Desert and the gorgeous NT watering holes. It’s also a fascinating spot to explore Australia’s Aboriginal culture.
 
 
  • Option for ABN - increased hourly rate!
  • Option for PAYG + living away from home tax benefits - more take home pay!
 
 
Working in regional Australia offers the chance to work within close knit communities. As part of smaller teams, you will access a wider range of patients and develop your clinical expertise. These roles offer great rates of pay, accommodation and the chance to broaden your skill set within a range of healthcare settings.
 
 

To apply for this role or to enquire about our other vacancies, please contact Rachael – Allied Health Division Lead at CC Medical on 0452 189 556 or email rachaeld@ccjobs.com.au

job.title: Senior Specialist / Specialist - General Medicine Physician and Geriatrician
job.description:
Senior Specialist / Specialist - General Medicine Physician and Geriatrician
Coastal Regional Queensland
Permanent full-time | 80 hours per fortnight
Total remuneration package up to $564,548 per annum

Advance your career and make coastal Queensland home
Are you a dual-trained General Medicine Physician and Geriatrician looking for a senior role offering clinical variety, leadership opportunities and a lifestyle that leaves time for living?
A major regional referral hospital in coastal Queensland is seeking an experienced specialist to join its collaborative Department of Medicine. This permanent appointment combines a broad and rewarding clinical scope with excellent remuneration, private practice potential and an enviable coastal lifestyle.

A lifestyle worth relocating for
Imagine finishing work and being only a short drive from uncrowded beaches, coastal walking tracks and waterways ideal for swimming, boating and fishing.
This beautiful part of Queensland offers a warm, sunny climate and a relaxed pace of life, with the space and affordability to enjoy it. Whether your ideal weekend involves exploring the Southern Great Barrier Reef, camping in a national park, surfing, dining on fresh local produce or simply spending time outdoors with family, the region makes work–life balance feel achievable.

You can enjoy:
  • Beautiful beaches and year-round outdoor living
  • Easy access to the Southern Great Barrier Reef
  • Boating, fishing, swimming, surfing and camping
  • National parks, coastal trails and abundant wildlife
  • Quality schools and family-friendly communities
  • Excellent shopping, dining, sporting and cultural facilities
  • More affordable housing than Queensland’s major cities
  • Shorter commutes and less congestion
  • Convenient road and air connections to Brisbane
  • A welcoming community where specialists are genuinely valued
This is an opportunity to build a rewarding specialist career while enjoying more space, less pressure and a lifestyle many people only experience on holiday.

The opportunity
You will provide high-quality specialist care to patients with complex general medical and geriatric needs across:
  • Acute and subacute inpatient services
  • Ambulatory and outpatient care
  • Community-based programs
  • Virtual models of care
  • Multidisciplinary clinical services
The position is pivotal in developing contemporary models of care for frail older people. You will provide senior clinical leadership, contribute to clinical governance and service improvement, and support the education and supervision of junior medical staff.

You will join a welcoming multidisciplinary team where your expertise in both General Medicine and Geriatrics will be highly valued—and where you can make a visible difference to patients, services and the wider community.

Private practice potential
The successful candidate may also have the opportunity to establish a private practice outside their public appointment, with potential assistance including:
  • Access to sessional consulting rooms
  • Credentialling and administrative support
  • Introductions to local GPs, physicians and surgeons
  • Assistance establishing local referral pathways
Exceptional remuneration and benefits
The total remuneration package is valued at up to $564,548 per annum, including:
  • Base salary of $223,136–$282,912 per annum
  • Employer superannuation contributions of up to 12.75%
  • General Attraction and Retention Allowance
  • Regional and Rural Attraction Allowance
  • Motor Vehicle Allowance
  • Professional Development Allowance
  • Paid Professional Development Leave
  • Annual leave loading of 17.5%
  • Salary-packaging options
  • Flexible working arrangements
The hospital
This established regional referral hospital provides an extensive range of acute, specialist and community healthcare services to a large and growing population.
The Department of Medicine offers a diverse clinical environment supported by committed multidisciplinary teams and strong links across inpatient, outpatient and community services. You will have genuine scope to influence service development, introduce contemporary models of care and improve outcomes for older people across the region.

Essential requirements
Applicants must hold, or be eligible to obtain:
  • Specialist registration with AHPRA
  • Fellowship of the Royal Australasian College of Physicians, or recognised equivalent specialist qualifications
  • Specialist qualifications and experience in General Medicine and Geriatric Medicine
Ready to make your move?
If you are an experienced General Medicine Physician and Geriatrician looking for a senior specialist opportunity in a supportive regional environment, we would love to hear from you.
To express your interest, please provide your current CV, details of your specialist registration and Fellowship/qualifications, and your anticipated availability.

For a confidential discussion about the role please contact:

Nicki Wade
Senior Recruitment Consultant – Permanent Doctors
CC Medical
P: +61 401 010 048
E:nickiw@ccjobs.com.au

job.title: Locum Radiologist
job.description:
Looking for a locum opportunity that gives you a great mix of work and lifestyle?

This Radiologist role in Coffs Harbour offers daytime hours, no on-call and accommodation provided, making it an easy option for a short break from the usual routine.


The opportunity
 
  • Hours: 08:00 – 17:00
  • Rate: $3,500 per day
  • Hospital Setting
  • On-call: Not required
  • Travel: $450 travel allowance for each block of dates
  • Accommodation: Provided by the service


Dates:
 
  • 16 October – 19 October 2026
  • 31 October – 2 November 2026
  • 6 November – 10 November 2026
  • 13 November – 17 November 2026
  • 5 January – 7 January 2027


Discover Coffs Harbour

Located on the NSW Mid North Coast, Coffs Harbour offers the perfect combination of coastal living and a relaxed regional lifestyle. With beautiful beaches, rainforest, national parks and plenty of cafés and restaurants to explore, there is plenty to enjoy outside of work.

Whether you want to spend your downtime by the water, explore the surrounding coastline or simply enjoy a slower pace of life, Coffs Harbour is a great place to spend a locum block.

How do I Apply?

job.title: VMO/Specialist – Obstetrics & Gynaecology
job.description:
VMO/Specialist – Obstetrics & Gynaecology
Help shape women’s healthcare in a brand-new regional hospital
Visa sponsorship: Potentially available for eligible applicants

An exciting opportunity is available for an experienced Obstetrician and Gynaecologist to join the team preparing for the opening of the new Regional Hospital in 2027.
This is a rare opportunity to help establish and shape contemporary women’s health services within a purpose-built hospital, while enjoying an exceptional coastal lifestyle.

Location and lifestyle
It offers a relaxed coastal lifestyle surrounded by beaches, national parks, waterways and welcoming regional communities.
Moruya is located:
  • Approximately two hours from Canberra
  • Under four hours’ drive from Sydney
  • Close to the Coast
  • Within easy reach of beaches, boating, fishing, cycling, bushwalking and other outdoor activities
The region offers an attractive alternative to metropolitan living, with shorter commutes, a strong sense of community and access to relocation support.

The hospital
Currently under construction the Hospital will deliver state-of-the-art facilities and expanded clinical services to communities.
The new hospital is designed to accommodate future growth, it will provide a modern environment in which clinicians can influence service development, clinical pathways and models of care from the outset.

The role
As a VMO/Specialist in Obstetrics and Gynaecology, you will provide comprehensive specialist care across obstetrics, maternity services and a broad range of gynaecological presentations.
You will:
  • Manage routine and complex obstetric and gynaecological presentations
  • Work independently in managing complex and emergency cases appropriate to the service’s role delineation
  • Collaborate with medical, midwifery, nursing, allied health and support teams
  • Contribute to the development of safe, contemporary clinical pathways and models of care
  • Provide clinical leadership to junior doctors and other members of the multidisciplinary team
  • Participate in undergraduate and postgraduate teaching, supervision and professional development
  • Support clinical governance, audit, quality improvement and patient-safety initiatives
  • Work collaboratively across services and hospital sites within the Local Health District
This position will suit a specialist who is motivated by the opportunity to make a meaningful contribution to a growing regional service and help build the future of women’s healthcare on the NSW South Coast.

Essential requirements
Applicants must have:
  • Specialist registration, or eligibility for specialist registration, with the Medical Board of Australia through AHPRA
  • FRANZCOG or an equivalent specialist qualification and recognition
  • Recent clinical practice and demonstrated expertise across obstetrics and gynaecology
  • The ability to work independently and manage complex emergencies appropriate to the service
  • Evidence of continuing professional development, clinical audit and quality-improvement participation
  • Experience teaching and supervising junior medical staff, trainees and students
  • Strong communication, teamwork and multidisciplinary collaboration skills
Specialist International Medical Graduates with an appropriate RANZCOG comparability outcome, or those who may be eligible for specialist recognition in Australia, are encouraged to enquire.

How to apply
If you’re an experienced Obstetrician and Gynaecologist interested in contributing to women’s healthcare on the NSW South Coast, click Apply to express your interest.

For a confidential discussion, contact:
Nicki Wade
Senior Medical Recruitment Consultant | CC Medical
Phone: +61 401 010 048
Email:nickiw@ccjobs.com.au

job.title: Head of Department – General Medicine
job.description:
Head of Department – General Medicine
Lead the development of medical services in a brand-new regional hospital
An exceptional opportunity is available for an experienced General Physician to lead the Department of Medicine within a major new hospital opening on the beautiful Southern New South Wales coast in 2027.

Larger than the region’s two existing hospitals combined, this purpose-built facility will deliver expanded, contemporary services to a growing community. This is a rare opportunity to help shape a new department, influence models of care and establish a strong clinical culture from the outset.

Located within easy reach of Canberra and less than four hours from Sydney, the region offers an enviable coastal lifestyle, affordable living, beautiful beaches and national parks, without sacrificing access to major centres.

The opportunity
As Head of Department – General Medicine, you will provide the clinical leadership, vision and strategic direction required to deliver safe, effective and patient-centred medical services.
Working collaboratively with senior executives, clinicians and multidisciplinary teams, you will:
  • Lead the strategic and operational development of the Department of Medicine
  • Help design and implement contemporary models of care for the new hospital
  • Promote clinical excellence, accountability and positive patient outcomes
  • Provide professional leadership, mentoring and support across the department
  • Oversee clinical governance, quality assurance and service-improvement initiatives
  • Support workforce planning, recruitment and performance management
  • Foster education, supervision, research and continuing professional development
  • Build effective relationships with patients, families and internal and external stakeholders
  • Participate in the relevant on-call roster and provide timely on-site clinical support
  • Help establish an inclusive, collaborative and high-performing departmental culture
While individual responsibilities may be delegated to other senior clinicians, the Head of Department will retain oversight of the department’s performance, outputs and outcomes.

About you
You will be an accomplished senior medical practitioner with:
  • Specialist registration, or eligibility for specialist registration, with AHPRA
  • Fellowship of the Royal Australasian College of Physicians in General and Acute Care Medicine, or an equivalent recognised qualification
  • A demonstrated record of clinical excellence and successful medical leadership
  • Experience leading multidisciplinary teams and complex clinical services
  • Strong written, verbal and interpersonal communication skills
  • A commitment to clinical governance, patient safety and continuous improvement
  • An active interest in teaching, supervision, research and workforce development
  • High levels of professionalism and a commitment to respectful, inclusive healthcare
  • Willingness to participate in the departmental on-call roster
Why consider this opportunity?
  • Take a leading role in establishing medical services within a brand-new hospital
  • Influence the department’s future direction, culture and models of care
  • Join a collaborative health service that values clinical leadership and innovation
  • Access salary-packaging arrangements and employee health and wellbeing benefits
  • Receive support with professional development and relocation
  • Enjoy an outstanding coastal lifestyle within reach of Canberra and Sydney
  • Visa sponsorship may be considered for suitably qualified applicants who meet the essential requirements
How to apply
If you’re interested in leading a new Department of Medicine and helping shape care for the community, we’d be pleased to hear from you.
For a confidential discussion about the role, contact Nicki Wade, Senior Medical Recruitment Consultant at CC Medical, on +61 401 010 048 or nickiw@ccjobs.com.au.

job.title: Emergency Medicine Specialist – FACEM
job.description:
Emergency Medicine Specialist – FACEM
Brand-New Hospital | Coastal Lifestyle | Help Shape a New Service
Located under four hours’ drive from Sydney and only two hours from Canberra.

Imagine joining a hospital before the doors open and having the opportunity to help shape its Emergency Department, clinical culture and models of care from the beginning.
We are seeking an experienced Emergency Medicine Specialist to join a new, purpose-built Level 4 regional hospital, scheduled to open in 2027.

More than a career move
Enjoy an enviable coastal lifestyle surrounded by beaches, waterways, national parks and relaxed communities while remaining within convenient reach of major metropolitan centres and airports.

The region offers:
  • Beautiful beaches and an abundance of outdoor activities
  • Excellent boating, fishing, surfing, cycling and bushwalking
  • More affordable housing than major capital cities
  • Short commutes and less time spent in traffic
  • Welcoming, family-friendly communities
  • A relaxed lifestyle without sacrificing professional challenge
  • Space to build a rewarding career and a better quality of life
Larger than the two existing hospitals it will replace, the facility will bring expanded specialist services together on one contemporary campus. It has also been designed with capacity for future growth as the surrounding community’s healthcare needs evolve.

A hospital designed for the future
The new hospital will offer:
  • A larger, purpose-built Emergency Department
  • The region’s first eight-bed Intensive Care Unit/Close Observation Unit
  • Contemporary operating theatres and a day-stay surgical unit
  • Expanded medical imaging, including MRI
  • Increased renal dialysis and chemotherapy capacity
  • Dedicated maternity, paediatric and special care nursery services
  • Mental health beds for short-term care
  • Modern teaching facilities, including a simulation laboratory
  • Contemporary clinical spaces designed to support multidisciplinary care
This is an outstanding opportunity to join an evolving service where your experience, ideas and leadership will make a genuine and lasting contribution.

The opportunity
You will provide high-quality emergency care across a broad and varied case mix while contributing to the development of the new department.
Your responsibilities will include:
  • Providing senior clinical leadership across the Emergency Department
  • Managing adult, paediatric, trauma, acute medical and surgical presentations
  • Supporting safe patient flow and effective clinical decision-making
  • Supervising and mentoring junior medical officers
  • Contributing to undergraduate and postgraduate teaching
  • Participating in clinical governance, quality improvement and patient-safety initiatives
  • Developing collaborative relationships across medical, nursing and allied health teams
  • Helping establish the systems, standards and culture of a new emergency service
  • Participating in evening, weekend and on-call rosters
What’s on offer
  • A senior role within a brand-new Level 4 hospital
  • The opportunity to influence a new Emergency Department from its foundation
  • A diverse and professionally rewarding clinical workload
  • Leadership, teaching and service-development opportunities
  • A collaborative multidisciplinary environment
  • Salary-packaging and employee wellbeing benefits
  • Relocation support for eligible applicants
  • Potential employer-sponsored visa support
  • An exceptional balance between career progression and coastal living
About you
Applicants should hold:
  • Specialist registration in Emergency Medicine with AHPRA and Fellowship of the Australasian College for Emergency Medicine; or
  • Specialist registration in General Practice with FRACGP or FACRRM, advanced qualifications in Emergency Medicine and appropriate recent senior experience.
You will bring strong clinical judgment, effective leadership and communication skills, a commitment to patient safety and clinical governance, and a genuine interest in teaching and supporting the next generation of doctors.

Build something that lasts
Joining a new hospital gives you the chance to help shape its Emergency Department from the beginning. Bring your expertise to regional emergency care while enjoying an outstanding coastal lifestyle.

How to apply
For a confidential conversation about the opportunity, contact Nicki Wade, Senior Medical Recruitment Consultant at CC Medical, on +61 401 010 048 or nickiw@ccjobs.com.au.

job.title: Specialist / Visiting Medical Officer General Surgery
job.description:
Specialist / Visiting Medical Officer – General Surgery
Shape the future of surgical care in a brand-new regional hospital on the beautiful NSW South Coast.
An exciting opportunity is available for an experienced General Surgeon to join the new Regional Hospital, currently under construction and scheduled to open in 2027.
This is a rare opportunity to help establish contemporary surgical services in a purpose-built hospital while enjoying an exceptional coastal lifestyle within easy reach of Canberra and Sydney.

The Hospital
The Hospital will be larger than the existing hospitals combined, bringing expanded services and state-of-the-art facilities to the region.
Designed to support future growth, the hospital will provide modern clinical environments and increased access to specialist care for the local community.
As a General Surgeon joining during this important period, you will have the opportunity to influence the development of surgical pathways, service delivery and clinical standards within the new facility.

The Opportunity
As a Specialist or Visiting Medical Officer in General Surgery, you will:
  • Deliver high-quality general surgical care across a broad range of presentations
  • Work collaboratively within a multidisciplinary clinical team
  • Contribute to the development of contemporary surgical services and patient pathways
  • Provide clinical leadership within the surgical department
  • Participate in teaching and supervision of junior medical staff
  • Support clinical governance, research, quality improvement and continuing education
  • Participate in the General Surgery on-call roster and respond onsite within a reasonable timeframe
About You
To be considered, you will ideally demonstrate:
  • Fellowship of the Royal Australasian College of Surgeons in General Surgery, or an equivalent specialist qualification
  • Eligibility for specialist registration with the Medical Board of Australia
  • Consideration may also be given to suitably qualified overseas-trained General Surgeons progressing through an approved specialist pathway
  • Recent and relevant clinical experience in General Surgery appropriate to the service’s role delineation
  • Strong multidisciplinary teamwork and clinical leadership capabilities
  • Excellent written, verbal, interpersonal and digital communication skills
  • A commitment to teaching, continuing professional development, research and quality improvement
  • Availability to participate in the on-call roster
Why
The region offers an enviable coastal lifestyle surrounded by beaches, national parks, rivers and welcoming communities.
  • Live and work on the spectacular NSW South Coast
  • Approximately two hours from Canberra
  • Less than four hours’ drive from Sydney
  • Easy access to Bay and surrounding coastal communities
  • Enjoy swimming, boating, fishing, surfing, bushwalking and cycling
  • Benefit from shorter commutes, a relaxed pace of life and a strong sense of community
  • An attractive location for individuals, couples and families seeking greater work–life balance
What Is Offered
  • Specialist or VMO appointment options
  • The opportunity to help shape surgical services within a new hospital
  • A supportive multidisciplinary team that values your expertise
  • Professional development, teaching and clinical leadership opportunities
  • Salary packaging options
  • Health and wellbeing benefits, including Fitness Passport
  • Relocation information and support for candidates moving to the region
  • Employment within Southern NSW Local Health District
This is an outstanding opportunity for a General Surgeon to combine meaningful clinical practice and service development with an exceptional coastal lifestyle.

How to Apply
If this opportunity interests you, please apply with your current CV. For further information or a confidential discussion, please contact:

Nicki Wade
Senior Recruitment Consultant – Permanent Doctors
CC Medical
Phone: +61 401 010 048
Email: nickiw@ccjobs.com.au

job.title: Consultant/Specialist Anaesthetist – Tropical Northern Australia
job.description:
Consultant/Specialist Anaesthetist – Tropical Northern Australia
Salary package up to AU$617,000, dependent on experience
Full-time and fractional appointments available

Six weeks’ annual leave | Relocation assistance | Exceptional lifestyle
IMG Anaesthetists who have been assessed by ANZCA as substantially comparable will be considered
This is an outstanding opportunity to work as a Consultant/Specialist Anaesthetist in one of Australia’s most adventurous, culturally diverse and clinically rewarding regions.
Join a major tertiary teaching hospital providing complex specialist care across an immense geographical area. You will work with a supportive multidisciplinary team, manage a varied and challenging caseload and make a meaningful contribution to healthcare delivery for regional, remote communities.

A lifestyle beyond the ordinary
This is Australia on a grand scale ancient landscapes, tropical coastline, extraordinary wildlife and adventure in every direction.
Spend your time away from work exploring iconic national parks, swimming beneath waterfalls, fishing in remote waterways, camping beneath open skies or setting off on a four-wheel-drive journey through the outback.

The tropical city offers a relaxed and welcoming lifestyle, excellent schooling and childcare options, short commutes and considerably more time to enjoy life outside work. The hospital’s coastal cycling route makes even the daily commute memorable.

Southeast Asia is also on your doorstep. Bali is approximately three hours away by air, while Singapore can be reached in around four hours making an international weekend away entirely possible.

For anaesthetists seeking complex clinical work, professional purpose and a genuine sense of adventure, few Australian locations offer a more distinctive opportunity.

The benefits
  • Lucrative remuneration package of up to AU$617,000, depending on experience
  • Six weeks of annual recreation leave
  • Two weeks of study leave annually
  • Relocation assistance and short-term subsidised accommodation
  • Full-time and flexible fractional appointments
  • Protected clinical support and professional-development time
  • Opportunities to contribute to Indigenous health and improve access to specialist care
  • Exposure to a younger and culturally diverse patient population
  • Potential opportunities in private practice, retrieval medicine and regional outreach
  • A supportive, inclusive and professionally diverse specialist department
The role
You will provide high-quality specialist services in:
  • Anaesthesia
  • Acute pain management
  • Regional anaesthesia
  • Perioperative medicine
  • Emergency and trauma surgery
  • High-risk obstetrics
  • Paediatric anaesthesia
  • Diagnostic and interventional procedures
The principal hospital is a major tertiary referral and teaching facility supported by a second campus providing lower-acuity elective surgical services.
The health service manages approximately 14,000 procedures annually and provides most surgical specialties, excluding cardiac surgery. The caseload includes significant emergency and trauma activity, complex obstetrics and approximately 15% paediatric work.

The service is supported by an 18-bed Intensive Care Unit with ECMO capability and a Level 5 Neonatal Intensive Care Unit. The hospital also has a nationally recognised role in trauma, critical-care and disaster-response medicine.

Specialists are encouraged to participate in education, clinical governance, service development, research, quality and safety, sustainability and staff wellbeing. Teaching opportunities are available across a broad trainee population, including anaesthetic registrars, Provisional Fellows, GP Anaesthetic trainees, critical-care trainees, junior doctors and medical students.

Requirements
Applicants must hold, or be eligible to obtain, specialist registration with the Medical Board of Australia through AHPRA.
Applicants should hold Fellowship of the Australian and New Zealand College of Anaesthetists who have been assessed by ANZCA as substantially comparable

How to Apply
If you are an experienced Anaesthetist interested in combining high-level specialist practice with an exceptional tropical lifestyle, we would be pleased to hear from you.

For a confidential discussion about the opportunity, please contact:
Nicki Wade
Senior Medical Recruitment Consultant – CC Medical
Phone: +61 401 010 048
Email: nickiw@ccjobs.com.au

job.title: Specialist / Visiting Medical Officer – General Medicine
job.description:
Specialist / Visiting Medical Officer – General Medicine
Permanent Full-Time | Coastal NSW
General Medicine with Subspecialty Practice | Relocation Assistance
Combine rewarding General Medicine practice with your subspecialty interests in a welcoming coastal community.

An excellent opportunity is available for an experienced General Physician to join a collaborative and well-established medical team in regional NSW. The role offers clinical variety, professional autonomy and opportunities to contribute to service development, education and clinical leadership.

The opportunity
This position offers an attractive balance of broad General Medicine and subspecialty practice:
  • 0.5 FTE General Medicine: Inpatient care across general medical wards, alongside consultations for ICU, HDU and Emergency Department patients.
  • 0.5 FTE subspecialty practice: Geriatric Medicine, Cardiology, Endocrinology, Infectious Diseases, Neurology or Gastroenterology.
You will join a friendly and collegial department supported by experienced clinicians, multidisciplinary teams and engaged hospital management.

The hospital continues to develop, with planned infrastructure upgrades including a new inpatient building and a transition to digital patient records. Strong links with the University of Newcastle and Hunter Medical Research Institute support opportunities in teaching and research.

Enjoy the coastal lifestyle
Located approximately two hours north of Newcastle and 3.5 hours north of Sydney, the region offers a relaxed coastal and country lifestyle with a temperate climate, affordable living and excellent public and private schools.

Beautiful beaches, rivers, waterways and national parks provide plenty of ways to enjoy your time outside work. Established regional amenities, a welcoming community and minimal commuting make the area an appealing place to build both a career and a life.

Convenient flight connections to capital cities and access to major metropolitan centres add to the region’s appeal.

Benefits
  • Permanent full-time opportunity
  • Choice of Staff Specialist or Visiting Medical Officer appointment
  • Relocation assistance
  • Salary packaging of up to $9,000 for living expenses
  • Additional salary packaging of up to $2,600 for meals and entertainment
  • Fitness Passport
  • Employee Assistance Program for employees and their families
  • Dedicated medical onboarding, credentialing and settlement support
  • Strong university and medical research links
  • Opportunities in service development, education and clinical leadership
About you
To be considered, you must:
  • Hold Fellowship of the Royal Australasian College of Physicians
  • Hold specialist registration with AHPRA
  • Demonstrate a commitment to high-quality, patient-centred care
  • Work effectively within a multidisciplinary team
  • Advocate for patients, the department and the broader community
  • Be committed to improving rural and regional health outcomes
International medical graduates requiring further upskilling or supervised practice cannot be considered for this appointment.

Build a rewarding career on the NSW coast
If you’re looking for a role that combines broad clinical practice, your subspecialty interests and an appealing coastal lifestyle, we’d be pleased to discuss this opportunity with you.
For a confidential conversation about the role and life in the region, contact Nicki Wade, Senior Medical Recruitment Consultant at CC Medical, on +61 401 010 048 or nickiw@ccjobs.com.au.

job.title: Consultant Psychiatrist – Intellectual & Developmental Disability
job.description:
What’s on offer
  • $400,000 – $550,000 p.a. + relocation allowance
  • Generous employer superannuation contribution of up to 12.75%
  • Flexible work arrangements to support work–life balance
  • A welcoming regional city with a relaxed lifestyle and natural beauty
About the role

This role will see you providing specialist psychiatric assessment and management for patients with intellectual disability and/or autism spectrum disorder, primarily through a Consultation-Liaison role supporting community and inpatient teams, with a small cohort of direct patient care.

The role provides professional leadership within a multidisciplinary mental health environment. There is also an opportunity to establish private practice alongside this appointment, with potential support including consulting rooms, credentialling, administrative assistance and introductions to local referral networks.

Relocating to Australia… support we can offer you
  • Forget Government Job Boards - We know our hospitals. We provide you with exclusive Psychiatrist job vacancies and direct link-ups with Mental Health Dept. Directors
  • Our recruitment service is FREE and personalised to your career and location requirements
  • Psychiatrist Peer to Peer Group Support with the RANZCP Specialist Assessment and Medical Board Applications
  • All Job applications prepared and submitted by our recruitment team.
  • Support with enrolling your children into leading private or state-run schools
  • Registered Migration Agent advice and support
Sound like you

job.title: Locum Hospital Social Worker
job.description:
• ASAP for 8-12 weeks
  • Flights covered + FREE accommodation
  • Locum rates upto $75 per hour + super

Experienced Social Worker required for this NT service. This is a remote 60 bed hospital. The service requires high level skills and demonstrated cultural competence working respectfully with Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander population. There is a high incidence of domestic and family violence, child neglect and abuse reporting and statutory child removal. 
 

To be considered, you will have:
 
  • Relevant qualifications in Social Work that meets membership eligibility requirements of the Australian Association of Social Workers.  
  • Experience in acute hospitals, including emergency department and general medicine wards
  • Experience in contemporary DFSV intervention, risk assessment and safety planning in regional and remote context. 
  • Proven ability to independently plan and prioritise a high-volume complex workload within an ever changing work environment. 
  • Ability to work extended hours, including weekends and after-hours shifts, on call (penalty rates apply)
  • This role is NOT suitable for new graduates or candidates who don't have PAID hospital experience
 
 
Cases include:
  • Sexual violence
  • ED presentations
  • Crisis response (adults and paediatrics)
  • Guardianship
  • Advocacy
  • NDIS applications
  • Inpatients only – ED, acute wards – general medical, surgical, palliative care, rehabilitation, maternity and paediatrics
  • You must have strong crisis response and experience with victims of domestic and sexual violence
  • Join a team of clinicians at different levels from Director, Team leaders, SWs, DTs, OTs, PTs, SPs, AHAs, ALOs, Admin 


You must have relevant experience.
This role requires you to be eligible for AASW membership
Overseas trained Social Workers, please do not respond unless your qualifications have been assessed by the AASW
 
Join my other locums who love this remote health service!
 
Return flights reimbursed (upto $1200) and free accommodation for locums. A driving license is required for this role.
 
Locum rates up to $75 per hour + super dependent on experience. Potential for living away from home benefits (more take home pay, usually $5-6 dollars more an hour!).
 
Come to where the Outback meets the tropics and discover a region full of gorges and misty waterfalls, thermal springs and ancient cultures. This region is a nature lovers paradise.
 


 
To apply for this role or to enquire about our other vacancies, please contact Rachael – Allied Health Division Lead at CC Medical on 0452 189 556 or email rachaeld@ccjobs.com.au


My contactable days are Monday – Friday. If you need to contact me over the weekend, please send an email.

job.title: Locum Hospital Physiotherapists required!
job.description:
Several vacancies for experienced hospital Physiotherapists across NSW and VIC.

  • Locum rates + travel + accommodation
  • Acute, subacute and MSK caseloads
  • Great feedback from other locums!



2 hours from Melbourne - Physiotherapist – acute inpatients and/or MSK caseload
  • ASAP start for 12-14 weeks
  • Accommodation available 
  • Experience Grade 1 or Grade 2
You must have 3 years minimum relevant experience and be able to add value to the team and provide support across the relevant clinical areas.
  • Acute inpatients, including medical, ED and respiratory caseloads; and/or
  • Outpatient musculoskeletal physiotherapy.
  • A clinician with broad hospital experience and the ability to work relatively independently would be ideal.
  • Accommodation available for contracts.
  • This is a fixed term contract, not a locum. You will accrue leave entitlements, sick pay etc….
 
 
 
2 hours from Canberra - Locum Hospital Physiotherapist – subacute caseload
  • 13th October for 6 weeks + possible extension
  • Inpatients – subacute caseload
  • Accommodation & travel provided
New locum with this regional NSW service. The location is based two hours from Canberra and four hours from Sydney.
The caseload will cover:
  • Subacute inpatients – rehab, geriatrics, palliative care in a public hospital setting
  • Support from senior clinicians available
  • Join a MDT including 5 Physiotherapist, senior support available
  • Locum rates upto $65 per hour + super
  • Potential for living away from home benefits (more take home pay, upto $6 dollars more an hour!).
  • Heavily subsidised accommodation, approx $73.50 per week (close to the hospital)
  • Up to $200 reimbursed for travel (with receipts)
I have placed multiple locum and permanent allied health clinicians with the service and always get great feedback! Most choose to extend their placement.
 
 

 
2.5  hours from Melbourne - Locum Hospital Physiotherapist – my favourite service
  • Early October start date until January 2027
  • Locum rates + FREE accommodation
  • Gorgeous VIC tourist hotspot!
Join this lovely regional health service based in Victoria, less than three hours from Melbourne. A great team, my other locums have loved this service. This inpatient caseload will cover:
  • Acute medical ward OR
  • Subacute rehab (with stroke experience)
  • Preferably you will have at least 3 years relevant hospital experience
  • I’ve worked with this service for many years and had great feedback!
  • Early October start date until January 2027 (possibly until Xmas TBC)
  • Locum rates based on experience
  • Potential for living away from home tax benefits (more take home pay, up to $6 dollars more an hour!)
  • Onsite accommodation available
 
I’ve had great feedback from other locums, who have really enjoyed their time with the service.
 
Gorgeous VIC location, which is a popular tourist hot spot! I’ve worked with this service for years and it is fabulous!
