job.title: Consultant Child Psychiatrists – Multiple Positions
job.description:
What’s on offer
  • $400,000 - $550,000 p.a. + relocation allowance
  • Multiple opportunities available across Brisbane
  • Generous leave, salary packaging and career development options
  • Easy access to a wide range of city facilities and amenities for all ages
  • Beautiful beaches, warm weather, outdoor adventures and a relaxed lifestyle
About the roles

Multiple opportunities are now available across the Brisbane region for passionate Child Psychiatrists to join dedicated teams delivering contemporary, recovery-focused care to children and young people up to 18 years experiencing severe and complex mental health conditions.

Working across inpatient and community settings, you’ll be part of a supportive and collaborative multidisciplinary team committed to providing high-quality, person-centred care. You’ll have the opportunity to undertake comprehensive assessment, deliver evidence-informed treatment and provide ongoing care tailored to the individual needs of each young person and their family.

These opportunities offer the chance to broaden your professional experience, develop your clinical expertise and build a rewarding career in child mental health. Most importantly, you’ll be joining a team where your skills, compassion and commitment can make a genuine and lasting difference to the lives of young people and their families.

Relocating to Australia… support we can offer you
  • Forget Government Job Boards - We know our hospitals. We provide you with exclusive Psychiatrist job vacancies and direct link-ups with Mental Health Dept. Directors
  • Our recruitment service is FREE and personalised to your career and location requirements
  • Psychiatrist Peer to Peer Group Support with the RANZCP Specialist Assessment and Medical Board Applications
  • All Job applications prepared and submitted by our recruitment team.
  • Support with enrolling your children into leading private or state-run schools
  • Registered Migration Agent advice and support
Sound like you

Contact Jonathan Richards, your Psychiatry Recruitment Specialist, to find out more about these roles and all they have to offer.

Tel: 0422408729

Email: jonathanr@ccjobs.com.au

About Jonathan Richards

“I have 15+ years’ experience connecting Psychiatrists with the best job opportunities across Australia. It is my passion and privilege to ensure you are being provided with the best recruitment services available.”

job.description:
Senior Specialist / Specialist – General Medicine Coastal Queensland | Package up to $572,732 | Rent-Free Furnished Home
Enjoy a relaxed coastal lifestyle, affordable living and short commutes while joining a supportive hospital undergoing significant growth.

An attractive permanent opportunity is available for a General Medicine Physician seeking an excellent remuneration package, diverse clinical practice and an affordable coastal lifestyle.
Based in a thriving coastal city with easy access to beaches, national parks and the Southern Great Barrier Reef, this role offers genuine opportunities to help shape an expanding medical service.

The growing regional hospital provides emergency care, general medicine, surgery, maternity, paediatrics, HDU and coronary care, orthopaedics, palliative care, imaging and pathology, with plans for further expansion. This is an excellent time to join the department and contribute to the continued development of General Medicine services across the region.

The opportunity
You will provide specialist General Medicine services across acute and inpatient settings while contributing to:
  • Clinical leadership and multidisciplinary patient care
  • Supervision and education of trainees, junior doctors and medical students
  • Clinical governance, patient safety and quality improvement
  • Outreach and telehealth services across the wider region
  • Research, teaching and academic medicine
  • The current 1:3 after-hours consultant on-call roster
The department supports RACP Basic Physician Training and Work-Based Assessment for international medical graduates.

Remuneration and benefits
A total remuneration package of up to $572,732 per annum is available, including:
  • 12.75% employer superannuation
  • Professional development allowance of $22,145 per annum
  • 3.6 weeks of professional development leave
  • Motor vehicle allowance
  • Overtime and on-call allowances
  • Attraction and retention incentives

  • Furnished accommodation with no weekly rent payable
  • Salary packaging and paid parental leave

Essential requirements

  • Specialist registration, or eligibility for specialist registration, with AHPRA
  • FRACP in General Medicine or an equivalent recognised specialist qualification
  • Demonstrated experience delivering high-quality General Medicine services

How to apply

job.title: Consultant/Specialist Radiologist – FRANZCR
job.description:
Consultant/Specialist Radiologist – FRANZCR
Permanent part-time opportunities | Advanced imaging technology | Remuneration package up to $490,911
Opportunities to participate in teaching, research and service development

An outstanding opportunity is available for Radiologists to join South Australia’s largest public medical imaging network at a major metropolitan health precinct.
These permanent positions offer the opportunity to combine high-quality clinical practice with teaching, research, professional leadership and service development. You will join an established multidisciplinary imaging team during an exciting period of expansion, with new facilities and advanced imaging equipment scheduled for completion in late 2026.

Enjoy life in Adelaide
Based in Adelaide’s established suburbs, the health precinct offers convenient access to the CBD, Adelaide Hills, metropolitan beaches and highly regarded residential areas.
Adelaide combines the professional opportunities of a major capital city with an accessible and relaxed lifestyle. The city is known for its excellent food and wine, festivals, beaches, parklands, quality schools and comparatively manageable commute times.

This is an excellent opportunity for a Radiologist seeking advanced imaging facilities, a collegial public health environment and the lifestyle advantages of one of Australia’s most liveable cities.

The opportunity
As a Consultant/Specialist Radiologist, you will provide comprehensive diagnostic imaging services across a range of modalities, including MRI, supporting public and private inpatients, outpatients and emergency presentations.

You will work closely with referring clinicians and multidisciplinary healthcare teams to deliver timely, accurate and patient-centred diagnostic services. The role also provides scope to contribute to clinical governance, quality improvement, education and the continued development of imaging services.

An expanding medical imaging service
The medical imaging department is undergoing a significant expansion designed to increase capacity and introduce the latest diagnostic technology.

The redevelopment includes:
  • Three additional ultrasound rooms
  • A new 3T MRI
  • New photon-counting CT technology
  • Modernised clinical and patient facilities
  • Expanded diagnostic capability within a growing health precinct
About you
You will be a skilled and collaborative Consultant/Specialist Radiologist with a strong commitment to clinical excellence, education and patient-centred care.

To be considered, you will require:
  • Fellowship of the Royal Australian and New Zealand College of Radiologists in Clinical Radiology, or an equivalent recognised specialist qualification
  • Eligibility for specialist registration with the Medical Board of Australia
How to apply
If this opportunity aligns with your experience and career goals, we would welcome your application.
For further information or a confidential discussion, please contact Nicki Wade, Senior Medical Recruitment Consultant at CC Medical, on +61 401 010 048 or nickiw@ccjobs.com.au.

job.title: Specialist Radiation Oncology
job.description:
Specialist – Radiation Oncology
Major Tertiary Cancer Centre | Coastal North Queensland
Advance your career in a highly equipped tertiary cancer centre while enjoying an affordable, relaxed coastal lifestyle in tropical North Queensland.
Salary package up to $500k plus - FRANZCR—or eligibility to obtain FRANZCR within 12 months

An outstanding opportunity is available for a Specialist in Radiation Oncology to join a major tertiary referral and teaching hospital.
This position offers exposure to complex and varied oncology presentations, advanced radiation therapy technology, multidisciplinary clinical practice, registrar supervision and meaningful research opportunities.

The Location
Based in a vibrant coastal city in Queensland, this opportunity provides the professional scope of a major tertiary centre without the congestion and cost associated with a capital city.

The region offers:
  • An affordable housing market and excellent lifestyle value
  • Short, convenient daily commutes
  • Established schools, universities and family amenities
  • A relaxed outdoor lifestyle throughout the year
  • Easy access to tropical islands, beaches, national parks and the Great Barrier Reef
  • Boating, fishing, diving, hiking and other outdoor activities
  • A well-connected regional airport with regular flights to major Australian cities
  • A welcoming community with the services and infrastructure of a substantial regional centre
  • This is an exceptional opportunity to combine advanced tertiary oncology practice, research and teaching with a genuinely attractive coastal lifestyle.
The Hospital and Cancer Centre
You will join one of Australia’s leading non-metropolitan tertiary hospitals and a major referral centre. The hospital provides a broad range of specialist and subspecialist services and maintains strong partnerships with a nearby university medical school.

The comprehensive cancer centre brings together radiation oncologists, medical oncologists, haematologists, palliative care physicians, specialist nurses and allied health professionals.
Its advanced facilities include:
  • Five linear accelerators with Hexapod technology
  • MRI-guided linear accelerator technology
  • 4D cone beam CT
  • Stereotactic brain and body radiotherapy
  • 4DCT simulation
  • HDR brachytherapy for gynaecological cancers
  • Superficial radiation therapy
  • Real-time transperineal prostate ultrasound tracking
  • Access to 3T MRI and advanced PET imaging, including FDG, Gallium-68 PSMA and DOTATATE
The centre provides contemporary investigation and treatment options locally, allowing patients across a vast regional catchment to access high-quality specialist cancer care closer to home.

The Opportunity
You will provide tertiary referral radiation oncology services in accordance with professional, ethical and evidence-based standards.
The cancer centre is accredited for five radiation oncology registrar training positions and offers an excellent environment for specialists with an interest in education, supervision and professional development.

Research is strongly encouraged, including original projects, international technology collaborations and participation in multicentre trials, with a particular emphasis on TROG research.

About You
To be considered, you should demonstrate:
  • Clinical experience in Radiation Oncology to a standard recognised by AHPRA and RANZCR
  • Fellowship of the Royal Australian and New Zealand College of Radiologist —FRANZCR—or eligibility to obtain FRANZCR within 12 months
Internationally qualified Radiation Oncologists holding a recognised specialist qualification are encouraged to enquire, subject to RANZCR specialist assessment and AHPRA registration requirements.

How to Apply
If this opportunity interests you, please apply with your current CV and include details of your AHPRA registration, FRANZCR status or RANZCR specialist assessment.
For more information or a confidential discussion, contact Nicki Wade, Senior Recruitment Consultant at CC Medical:
Phone: +61 401 010 048
Email: nickiw@ccjobs.com.au

job.title: Consultant/Specialist Anaesthetist | Coastal Queensland
job.description:
Consultant/Specialist Anaesthetist | Coastal Queensland Permanent full-time opportunities | Total remuneration package up to $564,548 p.a.

Imagine finishing a rewarding day in theatre with beaches, waterways and outdoor activities on your doorstep. This Queensland region offers the space and pace of coastal living, strong community connections and more affordable housing than many major cities. Direct flights to Brisbane, Sydney and Melbourne, along with road and rail links, make it easy to stay connected.

We are recruiting experienced Anaesthetists for several permanent full-time positions in a supportive multidisciplinary department. The recruitment process may also be used to fill positions at another hospital in the region.

The opportunity
You will provide specialist anaesthetic and related care across a broad range of surgical services, working closely with surgical, nursing and other clinical teams. You will also contribute to clinical leadership and supervise and train registrars, junior medical staff and other members of the healthcare team.

Flexible rostering is available to support life outside work.

What’s on offer
  • Total remuneration package up to $564,548 p.a., depending on classification and entitlements
  • Base salary of $192,257–$281,545 p.a.
  • Employer superannuation contributions of up to 12.75%
  • 17.5% annual leave loading
  • Clinical professional development allowance and paid professional development leave
  • Salary packaging options and flexible work arrangements
For Senior Medical Officers, there may also be an opportunity to establish a separate private practice outside the public hospital appointment. Depending on local arrangements, assistance may be available with credentialling, administration, consulting rooms and introductions to referral networks.

Who we’d like to hear from
We welcome enquiries from experienced Anaesthetists who hold FANZCA, have been assessed by ANZCA as substantially comparable, or may be eligible for the Medical Board of Australia’s expedited specialist pathway. International specialists considering a move to Australia are encouraged to get in touch to discuss the role and their individual pathway.

Ready for a coastal move? We’d love to hear from you. Apply through SEEK with your current CV, or contact Nicki Wade, Senior Recruitment Consultant at CC Medical, at nickiw@ccjobs.com.au for a confidential discussion.

job.title: Consultant Psychiatrist - Forensic
job.description:
What’s on offer
  • $400,000 - $550,000 p.a. + generous relocation allowance
  • Rewarding clinical leadership role
  • 40-hour work week - flexible working arrangements
  • Salary packaging, generous leave and wellbeing programs
  • Easy access to Brisbane CBD, vibrant communities and a relaxed lifestyle
About the role

This forensic psychiatry role offers the opportunity to join a major health service dedicated to meeting the future needs of individuals and families across Queensland’s southeast region. This permanent, full-time position involves delivering high-quality services within high-security inpatient programs; providing clinical leadership, mentoring and guidance to multidisciplinary teams; and contributing to comprehensive assessment and treatment planning using a recovery-oriented approach. The role also includes consultation-liaison services and opportunities to support the training and professional development of junior doctors and other medical staff.
 
Relocating to Australia… support we can offer you
  • Forget Government Job Boards - We know our hospitals. We provide you with exclusive Psychiatrist job vacancies and direct link-ups with Mental Health Dept. Directors
  • Our recruitment service is FREE and personalised to your career and location requirements
  • Psychiatrist Peer to Peer Group Support with the RANZCP Specialist Assessment and Medical Board Applications
  • All Job applications prepared and submitted by our recruitment team.
  • Support with enrolling your children into leading private or state-run schools
  • Registered Migration Agent advice and support
Sound like you

Contact Jonathan Richards, your Psychiatry Recruitment Specialist, to find out more about this role and all it has to offer.

Tel: 0422408729

Email: jonathanr@ccjobs.com.au

About Jonathan Richards

“I have 15+ years’ experience connecting Psychiatrists with the best job opportunities across Australia. It is my passion and privilege to ensure you are being provided with the best recruitment services available.”

job.title: Locum Clinical Pharmacist
job.description:
• ASAP start for 13 weeks (or less if preferred)
  • Locum rates + travel + accommodation
  • Gorgeous NSW location!
 
Experienced Clinical Pharmacists required for locums in gorgeous Northern Rivers, NSW. To be considered you will be a clinical hospital pharmacist experience that is comfortable covering: ICU, CCU, General Medical, Surgical, O&G, Emergency.


You must have Australian hospital experience.

  • ASAP start for 13 weeks (or less if preferred)
  • The hours of work are 8am-4:30pm Monday – Friday
  • The facility is a level 3 /4 hospital
  • EMR/Ipharmacy experience preferred
  • Accommodation can be provided – families welcome
  • Travel reimbursed
  • Locum rates up to $80 per hour depending on experience + superannuation, up to $100 for ABN
  • Option for PAYG living away from home tax benefits ($7/8 dollars per hour more)
 
This regional city is the gateway to the wild rivers, ravishing gorges and ancient rainforest of nearby Nymboida National Park. Here, forest-clad escarpments create a striking backdrop for paddling, hiking, camping and 4WD touring. Enjoy white water rafting, canoeing and river tubing tours or you can take a multi-day camping river tour or hire canoes. The location also has a rich history and a thriving food scene.

job.title: Consultant/Specialist – Obstetrics & Gynaecology
job.description:
Consultant/Specialist – Obstetrics & Gynaecology
Regional Queensland | 90 Minutes from Brisbane | Package up to $481,935 + Super
IMG’s eligible for expedited pathway or RANZCOG assessed as substantially comparable with be considered.

An excellent opportunity is available for a Consultant/Specialist in Obstetrics and Gynaecology to join a major accredited teaching hospital within easy reach of Brisbane.
You will provide comprehensive specialist care while contributing to clinical leadership, education and the continued development of women’s health services across a large and diverse regional community.

The position
Working within a supportive multidisciplinary team, you will:
  • Deliver high-quality obstetric and gynaecological care across inpatient, outpatient and procedural settings.
  • Manage a varied clinical caseload and support safe, coordinated patient care.
  • Provide clinical leadership, supervision and education to junior medical staff.
  • Participate in quality improvement, clinical governance and service development.
  • Promote evidence-based practice and positive healthcare outcomes for women and families.
  • Support the delivery of services to surrounding rural communities.
The lifestyle
Enjoy the space and affordability of regional living without losing convenient access to Brisbane.
This modern city offers:
  • Excellent public and private schools
  • Two universities and vocational education providers
  • Affordable housing and short commutes
  • Restaurants, galleries, museums and excellent shopping
  • Extensive sporting and recreational facilities
  • A temperate climate with four distinct seasons
  • A welcoming, family-friendly community
This is an outstanding opportunity to progress your career, take on meaningful clinical leadership responsibilities and enjoy a genuine work-life balance.

The hospital and health service
The principal hospital is a 364-bed accredited teaching and regional referral centre. It forms part of an integrated health network providing services to approximately 300,000 people across 29 facilities.
The broader network includes:
  • A major regional referral hospital
  • Three regional hub hospitals
  • Twelve rural hospitals
  • An extended inpatient mental health service
  • Three multipurpose health services
  • Community outpatient clinics
  • Residential aged-care facilities
  • Comprehensive acute, mental health, aged-care, community and allied health services
Remuneration and benefits
A competitive remuneration package valued at up to $481,935 is available, including:
  • Motor vehicle allowance
  • Regional attraction allowance
  • Professional development allowance
  • 3.6 weeks of professional development leave annually
  • Private practice arrangements
  • Professional indemnity cover
  • Salary packaging
  • Flexible working arrangements
  • Fitness Passport and employee wellbeing benefits
Superannuation of up to 12.75% and annual leave loading of 17.5% are payable in addition to the total remuneration package.

Essential requirements
Applicants should hold:
  • Specialist registration with the Medical Board of Australia in Obstetrics and Gynaecology; or
  • Qualifications and experience eligible for specialist registration or an approved equivalent pathway
Experience supporting rural health services, teaching junior doctors or contributing to service development would be highly regarded.
This is an outstanding opportunity to progress your career, take on meaningful clinical leadership responsibilities and enjoy a genuine work-life balance.

job.description:
Specialist – Obstetrics & Gynaecology
Beautiful NSW Region | Permanent | Full-time or Part-time | Up to 1.125 FTE
  • FRANZCOG or an accepted equivalent specialist qualification
  • Join a major referral and teaching hospital delivering specialist care to one of Australia’s fastest growing and most culturally diverse communities.
Combine tertiary-level practice with an enviable lifestyle in one of New South Wales’ most spectacular regions.
An exciting opportunity is available for experienced Obstetricians and Gynaecologists to join a progressive Women’s Health service working across metropolitan and regional hospital settings.
Whether you are seeking professional variety, a stronger work-life balance or the opportunity to raise your family in a beautiful natural environment, this position offers an exceptional combination of career and lifestyle.

An outstanding place to live
Enjoy a lifestyle without giving up access to metropolitan services.
The region offers:
  • World Heritage-listed national parks
  • More than 140 kilometres of walking trails
  • Waterfalls, canyoning, cycling and year-round outdoor recreation
  • Welcoming communities with cafés, boutique shopping, local markets and arts festivals
  • Highly regarded schools and family-friendly amenities
  • Convenient train access to Sydney in approximately 1–1.5 hours
  • More space and a relaxed pace of life within reach of a major capital city
Supporting more than 4,000 births each year, the service offers a diverse and rewarding clinical caseload with access to:
  • Maternal Fetal Medicine
  • Complex obstetric and gynaecological care
  • Robotic surgery
  • Tertiary and regional clinical environments
  • Teaching, research and academic opportunities
  • Clinical governance and service development
You will join a highly collaborative multidisciplinary team committed to clinical excellence, innovation and the delivery of safe, inclusive and patient-centred care.

The opportunity
This permanent role offers:
  • Up to 1.125 FTE, with full-time and part-time arrangements considered
  • A varied role across tertiary and regional hospital services
  • Excellent subspecialty exposure
  • A supportive and collegiate specialist team
  • Opportunities to teach and supervise junior medical staff
  • Career development and potential academic affiliation
  • Relocation assistance
  • Applicable rural incentives
  • Genuine work-life balance
About you
You will have:
  • FRANZCOG or an accepted equivalent specialist qualification
  • Specialist registration, or eligibility for specialist registration, with AHPRA
  • Contemporary experience across Obstetrics and Gynaecology
  • Strong communication and multidisciplinary teamwork skills
  • A commitment to teaching, supervision and quality improvement
  • An interest in rural service delivery, research or service development
Take the next step
Bring your specialist expertise to a service where you can enjoy clinical variety, contribute to the future of Women’s Health and make the most of life in this beautiful NSW region.

New locum role available in North West Tasmania. The start date is flexible for upto three months. You will be either ward or dispensary based.
 
You will work as a part of the relevant Hospital’s Pharmacy Department and Hospital’s Pharmacy Team to provide a comprehensive, efficient and accountable pharmacy service for hospital inpatients and outpatients.
 
You will have:
  • Pharmacy experience in a range of activities such as dispensing or clinical pharmacy, preferably in a hospital setting, together with experience in the application of relevant legislation, codes of practice and workplace guidelines in the practice of pharmacy.
  • An understanding of (and preferably experience with) the frameworks used to guide and develop clinical pharmacy services, such as the APAC Guidelines, Pharmaceutical Review, and Medication Management Review programs (e.g., HMR and DMMR).
  • Demonstrated working knowledge of the application of the Pharmaceutical Benefits Scheme.
  • Knowledge of aseptic manufacturing techniques.
  • Ability to assess and evaluate drug regimens and medicines information and provide tailored advice to other healthcare professionals and the patient.
  • Well-developed communication and interpersonal skills, and the ability to contribute effectively as an active member of a diverse, multidisciplinary team.
  • History of contributing positively to the workplace and delivering workplace improvements within a continuous quality improvement framework.
  • Demonstrated problem solving and conflict resolution skills applied to resolve practice-based issues.

 
Locum rates upto $75 per hour, dependent on experience + there is potential for living away from home tax benefits (more take home pay, up to $6 dollars more an hour!)

job.title: Specialist / Senior Specialist – Nephrology/Renal
job.description:
Specialist / Senior Specialist – Nephrology/Renal
Lead. Teach. Innovate. Live tropical.
Tropical Queensland | Permanent full-time
Total remuneration package: up to $536,916 per annum

An outstanding opportunity is available for an experienced Nephrologist to join the expanding Renal Unit of a major tertiary referral service in tropical Queensland.
Combining complex clinical practice with leadership, teaching and research, this position offers genuine professional scope alongside an enviable coastal lifestyle.

The lifestyle
Enjoy tropical coastal living without compromising your career. The region offers:
  • Easy access to the Great Barrier Reef and tropical islands
  • Beaches, rainforests, national parks and hiking trails
  • Exceptional boating, fishing and adventure activities
  • Affordable housing and family-friendly communities
  • Short commutes and a relaxed pace of life
  • A unique blend of urban, regional, coastal and rural living
Build your career within a high-calibre tertiary service while enjoying more time and space outside work.

The opportunity
You will provide comprehensive specialist renal services across hospital, outpatient, community and outreach settings. Clinical responsibilities include:
  • Inpatient nephrology consultations
  • Outpatient renal clinics
  • Dialysis and home-based therapies
  • Telehealth and regional outreach services
  • Participation in the after-hours on-call roster
  • Clinical leadership, governance and service planning
  • Supervision and mentoring of junior medical staff and trainees
  • Undergraduate and postgraduate teaching
  • Research, innovation and quality-improvement activities
The Renal Unit is continuing to expand, including the development of a dedicated home therapies service. You will have the opportunity to contribute to this growth and help shape the future delivery of renal care across the region.

Why consider this role?
Join a highly skilled and collaborative multidisciplinary team within a leading tertiary referral service. You will manage a diverse and complex caseload while benefiting from:

  • Strong academic links with a respected Australian university
  • Excellent teaching and research opportunities
  • Structured professional-development pathways
  • Leadership and secondment opportunities
  • Access to contemporary clinical practice and specialist expertise
  • A supportive, inclusive and community-focused workplace
Remuneration and benefits
  • 4–6 weeks’ annual leave
  • 14%–17.5% annual-leave loading
  • 12.75% employer superannuation contribution
  • Salary-packaging options
  • Professional-development, education and training support
  • Relocation and additional incentives may be available, subject to eligibility
Essential requirements
Applicants must hold:
  • Medical qualifications eligible for registration with the Medical Board of Australia
  • Specialist registration, or eligibility for specialist registration, with AHPRA
  • Fellowship of the Royal Australasian College of Physicians in Nephrology, or an overseas specialist qualification eligible for assessment through the RACP
Experience supervising junior doctors, delivering undergraduate or postgraduate education, and contributing to clinical leadership will be highly regarded.
The position may involve outreach work and occasional travel to other facilities within the broader health service.

Take the next step
Bring your renal expertise to a growing service where you can contribute to clinical care, teaching and the development of home therapies, while enjoying life in tropical Queensland.

To discuss this opportunity confidentially, contact Nicki Wade, Senior Medical Recruitment Consultant at CC Medical, on 0401 010 048 or nickiw@ccjobs.com.au. To apply, please submit your current CV.

With an attractive salary package, generous relocation support, and excellent long-term career benefits, this is an outstanding opportunity for Radiographers seeking both professional growth and an exceptional lifestyle change.
  • Permanent full-time opportunity in a stable and supportive team
  • Work across both hospital and community clinic environments
  • Broad caseload including CT and General Radiography
  • Inpatient and outpatient exposure
  • Upskilling and ongoing professional development opportunities available
  • Salary package ranging from $98,800 – $120,000 + super
  • Paid parental leave benefits
  • Discounted private health insurance for family members
  • CPD allowance to support ongoing professional development
  • Relocation assistance up to $10,000
  • Initial 4 weeks accommodation and car hire provided

Qualifications and Requirements:
  • Qualifications in Medical Imaging (Bachelor of Science or equivalent)
  • Eligible to hold AHPRA registration & Western Australian Radiation Use Licence
  • CT exposure - with MRI advantageous
  • Experience with Siemens and Canon ideal

Location:

Located just south of Perth, Mandurah offers the perfect balance of coastal lifestyle and city convenience. Known for its stunning waterways, beaches, relaxed atmosphere, and growing café and dining scene, it’s an ideal location for professionals looking to enjoy a slower pace without sacrificing access to major amenities.

Perth Airport is approximately a 1-hour drive away, making interstate travel straightforward, with direct flights connecting Perth to all major Australian cities including Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, and Adelaide. Whether you’re relocating solo or with family, Mandurah provides an affordable coastal lifestyle with easy access to Western Australia’s capital city.

job.title: Cardiac Sonographer Permanent & Locum Opportunities - Perth, Western Australia.
job.description:
An exciting opportunity is available for an experienced Cardiac Sonographer to join a well-established and highly respected private cardiology provider in Perth.

This specialist practice delivers comprehensive cardiac services across multiple metropolitan and regional locations and is recognised for providing exceptional patient care through a collaborative team of experienced cardiologists, cardiac sonographers, and cardiac technicians.

Whether you're looking for a long-term career move or a short-term locum contract, this is an excellent opportunity to work with a supportive multidisciplinary team while gaining exposure to a diverse range of cardiac imaging.

 

Permanent Opportunity

Full-time and part-time positions available (Monday to Friday)

Benefits

  • $110,000 to $142,000 plus superannuation
  • Excellent work-life balance with a 38-hour working week
  • Structured in-house education and ongoing CPD support
  • Professional development allowance
  • Work alongside highly experienced Imaging Cardiologists with regular clinical teaching and feedback
  • Exposure to a broad range of echocardiography including:
    • Transthoracic Echocardiography
    • Stress Echocardiography
    • Inpatient and acute studies
    • Emergency Department, ICU and CCU imaging
    • Post-cardiac surgery imaging
    • Structural Heart and TAVI procedures
  • Opportunity to develop paediatric echocardiography skills
  • Supportive and collaborative team culture
  • Long-term career stability within a growing specialist organisation
  • Opportunities for regional work with additional earning potential
The Role

You will independently perform high-quality echocardiograms and assist with stress echocardiography while working across a variety of clinical settings including private hospitals, public hospitals and outpatient clinics.


You'll work closely with an experienced multidisciplinary team committed to delivering outstanding patient outcomes while maintaining the highest clinical standards.


About You

You will have:

  • Graduate Diploma (or equivalent) in Medical Ultrasound (Cardiac)
  • Current ASAR accreditation
  • Minimum 12 months post-qualification cardiac scanning experience within Australia
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills
  • A commitment to delivering exceptional patient care
  • Current CPR certification
  • Current Driver's Licence
  • National Police Clearance
  • Working With Children Check
  • Ability to travel between metropolitan and regional clinic locations when required

Also Available – 8 Week Locum Cardiac Sonographer

If you're looking for flexibility, an immediate start is available for an experienced Cardiac Sonographer to join the same highly regarded team on a locum basis.

Locum Highlights

  • ASAP start
  • Approximately 8-week contract.
  • $90 per hour + Super
  • Travel provided
  • Accommodation allowance of $700 per week
  • Full-time hours (38 hours per week)
  • Monday to Friday roster
  • Metro clinic hours generally between 8:30am and 5:30pm
  • Opportunity to work across private hospitals, public hospitals and outpatient clinics
  • Approximately 10 scans per day with 45-minute appointment times
  • Work across six metropolitan clinic locations, with regional opportunities available where appropriate
Whether you're relocating to Perth, looking for a rewarding permanent career, or seeking your next locum assignment, this is an outstanding opportunity to join one of Western Australia's most respected cardiac imaging teams.

job.title: Consultant/Specialist Obstetrician and Gynaecologist
job.description:
Consultant/Specialist Obstetrician and Gynaecologist
Coastal Metropolitan Australia | Permanent | Full-time, Part-time or Sessional
Remuneration package: $365,665–$465,018 per annum, pro rata

An excellent opportunity is available for Consultant Obstetricians and Gynaecologists to join a well-established public hospital within a major metropolitan health service.
The service is seeking to appoint two permanent Consultants, totalling 2.0 FTE, with flexibility to consider full-time, fractional, part-time or sessional arrangements.

The lifestyle
Enjoy a relaxed coastal lifestyle less than an hour from Perth CBD, offering the perfect balance between seaside living and convenient access to a major capital city.
The region offers:
  • Beautiful beaches, protected waterways and coastal reserves
  • Excellent boating, fishing, swimming and outdoor recreation
  • A relaxed, family-friendly community
  • More affordable housing than inner Perth
  • Established schools, shopping, dining and community facilities
  • Convenient access to Perth Airport and surrounding lifestyle destinations
The opportunity
Working within a collaborative multidisciplinary team, you will provide high-quality specialist obstetric and gynaecological care to a large and growing community.

You will:
  • Deliver comprehensive inpatient and outpatient specialist services
  • Provide clinical leadership across the Obstetrics and Gynaecology service
  • Promote patient safety, clinical governance and continuous improvement
  • Supervise, educate and support doctors in training and other healthcare professionals
  • Work closely with the Head of Department and fellow Consultants
  • Contribute to service planning and the achievement of clinical and operational standards
The hospital
Join a progressive regional metropolitan hospital supporting a catchment of more than 200,000 people.
The hospital provides an extensive range of services, including emergency medicine, acute and general medicine, surgery, maternity, paediatrics, neonatal care and mental health. You will become part of a health service committed to clinical excellence, research, innovation and developing its medical workforce.

Essential requirements
Applicants must hold, or be eligible to obtain:
  • Specialist registration with the Medical Board of Australia
  • Fellowship of RANZCOG or an equivalent specialist qualification recognised in Australia
  • Appropriate clinical credentials and scope of practice in Obstetrics and Gynaecology
Apply
Bring your specialist expertise to a collaborative Obstetrics and Gynaecology team while enjoying a coastal lifestyle close to Perth. To discuss the role confidentially, contact Nicki Wade on 0401 010 048 or nickiw@ccjobs.com.au.

Please submit your current CV. I look forward to discussing how this opportunity could fit your next career move.

Nicki Wade
Senior Medical Recruitment Consultant
CC Medical

job.title: Locum Occupational Therapist – outpatients & community
job.description:
• ASAP start for 8-12 weeks ++
  • Rural Generalist inc: community, outreach & outpatients
  • Locum rates + accommodation + travel


Experienced Occupational Therapist required for a vacancy based in regional Victoria. You will work alongside a small allied health team.
 
The Primary Care team comprises of a number of practitioners including: Dietetics, Occupational Therapist, Speech Pathologists, Physiotherapists, Health Promotion Officers, Exercise Physiologist, Social Workers, Nurse, Midwife, Allied Health Assistants, and Podiatry.  It is a predominately young and enthusiastic workforce. The staff provide services in the local area and outreach services to various small towns in the region. 
The caseload is across the spectrum from children through to the elderly and everything in between, including:

Paediatric clientele, Pre-NDIS clientele requiring support to access the NDIS, Community Aged Care – My Aged Care CHSP, HACC-PYP and HCP, Residential Aged Care, and Inpatient hospital – typically clientele who have been stepped down from the local Base Hospital.

There is a permanent Grade 2 role available also. Open to experienced Grade 1 clinicians looking to take a step up in their career.
 
I’ve had great feedback from previous candidates! Minimum two years experience required.
 
FREE accommodation available + locum rates $$. I’ve had great feedback from previous locums!

Travel reimbursement also available.

Locum rates upto $80 per hour + super, more for ABN + option for living away from home tax benefits ($6/7 dollars per hour more).

 
Working in regional Australia offers the chance to work within close knit communities. As part of smaller teams, you will access a wider range of patients and develop your clinical expertise. These roles offer great rates of pay, accommodation and the chance to broaden your skill set within a range of healthcare settings.


 
To apply for this role or to enquire about our other vacancies, please contact Rachael – Allied Health Division Lead at CC Medical on 0452 189 556 or email rachaeld@ccjobs.com.au


My contactable hours are Monday – Friday. If you need to contact me over the weekend, please send an email.
 


Register today for information on all of our vacancies.
 
View all our vacancies here: www.ccjobs.com.au

job.title: Senior Staff Specialist / Staff Specialist / SMO – Emergency Medicine
job.description:
Senior Staff Specialist / Staff Specialist / Senior Medical Officer – Emergency Medicine
Coastal Regional Queensland | Permanent | Full-time or Part-time
Total remuneration package up to $652,478 per annum

Shape the future of emergency care
This is an exceptional opportunity to join an established regional hospital as it transitions into a newly constructed $42 million, state-of-the-art Emergency Department.
The service is seeking experienced Emergency Medicine specialists and senior medical officers who want to combine hands-on clinical practice with leadership, education and service development.
You will have a genuine opportunity to influence the implementation of a contemporary, evidence-based model of care while helping develop a sustainable Emergency Medicine service for a growing regional community.

The location
Enjoy the lifestyle advantages of a thriving coastal Queensland community without sacrificing professional opportunity.

The region offers:
  • A relaxed coastal lifestyle with easy access to beaches, islands and the Southern Great Barrier Reef
  • Outstanding boating, fishing, camping and outdoor recreation
  • A warm climate and year-round outdoor living
  • Affordable housing compared with Australia’s major cities
  • Shorter commutes and an excellent work–life balance
  • Quality schools, childcare, shopping and community facilities
  • Regular air connections to Brisbane
  • A welcoming community with everything required for comfortable family living
It is an ideal location for doctors seeking meaningful clinical work, greater lifestyle flexibility and the opportunity to become part of a close-knit regional community.

The hospital
This busy regional hospital provides a broad range of acute and community-based services, including:
  • Emergency Medicine
  • General Medicine and Surgery
  • Maternity and Obstetrics
  • Paediatrics
  • Mental Health
  • Allied Health and community services
You will join a supportive multidisciplinary team and work closely with the Director of Emergency Medicine to deliver safe, responsive and patient-focused emergency care.
The new Emergency Department represents a significant investment in the region’s healthcare infrastructure and offers the successful doctor the rare opportunity to help shape clinical systems, workforce development and models of care from the ground up.

The role
You will:
  • Provide high-quality, safe and timely emergency medical care
  • Help develop and implement contemporary Emergency Department models of care
  • Support the Director with clinical, strategic and operational leadership
  • Participate in the department’s 24-hour on-call roster
  • Lead and contribute to clinical governance, accreditation, audit and quality improvement
  • Supervise and mentor specialist trainees, junior doctors and medical students
  • Deliver education to medical, nursing and allied health professionals
  • Support doctors progressing towards FACEM and FACRRM
  • Provide clinical support to surrounding regional services, including through Telehealth
  • Encourage innovation and service improvements that enhance patient outcomes
  • Contribute to research, professional development and clinical review
Some work across other facilities within the broader regional health service may be required according to operational needs and facility capability.

Who should apply?
Applications are encouraged from:
  • FACEM-qualified Emergency Physicians
  • IMGS specialist assessed as substantially comparable
Senior Medical Officer
Applicants must have:
  • Completion of the ACEM Fellowship Written Examination, with an expectation of meeting the remaining essential requirements within the next six months
Postgraduate qualifications relevant to generalist hospital practice will be highly regarded, including:
  • FACRRM
  • FRACGP
  • Advanced Skills Training in Emergency Medicine
  • Advanced Skills Training in Generalist Medicine
  • Appointment level will be determined according to qualifications, registration status, specialist recognition and experience.
Remuneration and benefits
A total remuneration package of up to $652,478 per annum

Take the Next Step
If you are looking for clinical variety, leadership opportunities, excellent remuneration and an enviable coastal lifestyle, we would welcome your application.

For a confidential discussion or further information, please contact:
Nicki Wade
Senior Medical Recruitment Consultant – Permanent Doctors
CC Medical
Phone: 0401 010 048
Email: nickiw@ccjobs.com.au

Experienced Hospital Physiotherapist required for this regional NSW service, close to gorgeous Yamba and Angourie! You must be available from 6th October – 6th November. The dates are not negotiable.
 
 
Join a small allied health team in this gorgeous NSW location. I’ve had great feedback from other locums! This role is full time, 38 hours per week.  The caseload will include:
 
  • General Adult Rehabilitation covering 10 beds
  • You’ll be working with an MDT including Allied Health, Nursing and a Staff Specialist Rehab
  • Open to experienced level 2 and 3 clinicians
  • Driving license is required
  • 6th October – 6th The dates are not negotiable.
  • Rehabilitation focus
  • FREE accommodation provided
  • This is a level 3 role. The locum rate is $76.90 + super + potential for living away from home tax benefits (more take home pay, up to $8 dollars more an hour!)
 
This role is based in the heart of the Northern Rivers, NSW. Close to the gorgeous coastal town of Yamba, the surf breaks of Angourie and the cute village of Maclean. A lovely location to spend some time.


Working in regional Australia offers the chance to work within close knit communities. As part of smaller teams, you will access a wider range of patients and develop your clinical expertise. These roles offer great rates of pay, accommodation and the chance to broaden your skill set within a range of healthcare settings.


 
To apply for this role or to enquire about our other vacancies, please contact Rachael – Allied Health Division Lead at CC Medical on 0452 189 556 or email rachaeld@ccjobs.com.au


My contactable hours are Monday – Friday. If you need to contact me over the weekend, please send an email.

job.title: Career Medical Officers/SMO - Emergency Medicine and/or Anaesthesia
job.description:
Career Medical Officers/SMO – Emergency Medicine and/or Anaesthesia
Salary package up to $180k
Build your critical care skills, broaden your experience and enjoy an exceptional regional lifestyle.

An established regional referral hospital is seeking enthusiastic and motivated Career Medical Officers (CMOs) and Senior Medical Officers (SMOs) to join its Emergency Medicine and Anaesthesia teams.
These positions offer an excellent opportunity to build a rewarding, long-term medical career within a supportive clinical environment. Working alongside experienced specialists and multidisciplinary teams, you will gain broad clinical exposure, develop your procedural and decision-making skills, and make a genuine difference to rural and regional communities.

Why Consider This Opportunity?
Enjoy an Outstanding Regional Lifestyle
Relocate to one of regional Australia’s most attractive and vibrant communities, offering the perfect balance between career development and quality of life.

Enjoy:
  • Affordable housing and a lower cost of living
  • Excellent public and private schools
  • Access to a leading university and strong educational facilities
  • A vibrant arts, cultural and dining scene
  • Short commutes and a relaxed pace of life
  • Spectacular national parks, waterfalls and outdoor adventures
  • Award-winning local food and wine experiences
  • Convenient transport connections to major capital cities
This is an ideal location for individuals, couples and families seeking space, affordability, strong community connections and genuine work–life balance.

Diverse and Rewarding Clinical Practice
Gain experience across a broad range of emergency, acute and critical care presentations. The varied clinical workload provides exposure to complex cases and procedures, allowing you to expand your scope of practice and strengthen your clinical confidence.

Supportive Team and Career Development
Join a collaborative medical workforce committed to education, supervision, mentoring and professional growth.
Whether your career interests lie in Emergency Medicine, Anaesthesia, Critical Care or Rural Generalist practice, this opportunity provides an excellent platform for further development.
Successful applicants will have the opportunity to progress towards a leadership role within the Emergency Department, including taking responsibility for night shifts, while working with direct support from Consultant FACEMs across other shifts.

Modern Regional Referral Hospital
Work within a well-equipped regional referral hospital that provides comprehensive emergency, acute and specialist services to a large regional population.
The hospital plays an essential role in supporting surrounding rural communities and offers professional variety and clinical responsibility that can be difficult to gain within larger metropolitan hospitals.

About You
To be considered for this opportunity, you will demonstrate:
  • Hold, or be eligible to obtain, General Registration with the Medical Board of Australia, with at least three years of postgraduate medical experience and appropriate clinical training.
  • Appropriate Emergency Medicine training and experience, with the capacity to progress towards a leadership role within the Emergency Department. This will include taking responsibility for night shifts, with direct support from Consultant FACEMs available on other shifts.
  • High-level clinical skills and demonstrated involvement in patient care, supervision, mentoring and teaching, together with the ability to exercise a moderate degree of professional independence.
  • A demonstrated commitment to improving clinical care, patient safety and risk-management processes, including the ability to work collaboratively within multidisciplinary teams to implement positive change.
Ready for Your Next Opportunity?
If you are ready to build your critical care skills, broaden your clinical experience and enjoy an exceptional regional lifestyle, we encourage you to apply.

For further information or a confidential discussion, please contact:
Nicki Wade
Senior Medical Recruitment Consultant – Permanent Doctors
Email: nickiw@ccjobs.com.au
Phone: 0401 010 048

job.title: Consultant Rehabilitation Physician
job.description:
Consultant Rehabilitation Physician
Tropical Queensland | Package up to $564,939
Applicants with equivalent overseas qualifications assessed as substantially comparable by the Faculty of Rehabilitation Medicine will also be considered.
Build a rewarding specialist career in one of Queensland’s major regional referral hospitals while enjoying a relaxed tropical lifestyle, affordable living and easy access to beautiful beaches, islands and national parks.
This is an outstanding opportunity for a Consultant Rehabilitation Physician to join a well-established Geriatric and Rehabilitation Service delivering inpatient, ambulatory and outreach care from a modern, purpose-built rehabilitation unit.

Enjoy an Exceptional Regional Lifestyle
Live in a vibrant tropical regional centre offering the convenience of a major city without the congestion or high cost of metropolitan living.
The region provides:
  • Affordable housing and a relaxed pace of life
  • Excellent schools and family-friendly communities
  • A thriving café, dining and cultural scene
  • Easy access to beaches, tropical islands and the Southern Great Barrier Reef
  • National parks, walking trails, fishing and boating
  • Regular air connections to major Queensland cities
  • Shorter commutes and more time to enjoy life outside work
This location is ideal for doctors seeking meaningful clinical work, career development and a genuinely balanced lifestyle.

The Hospital
Join a large regional referral and teaching hospital providing comprehensive specialist services across:
  • Rehabilitation and Geriatric Medicine
  • Emergency and General Medicine
  • Cardiology and Renal Medicine
  • Intensive Care and Anaesthetics
  • General Surgery, Orthopaedics, Urology and ENT
  • Paediatrics and Obstetrics & Gynaecology
  • Psychiatry, Palliative Care and Cancer Care
The hospital offers excellent clinical variety, modern facilities and strong multidisciplinary support. You will work alongside experienced medical, nursing and allied health professionals while contributing to education, service development and clinical leadership.

The Opportunity
You will provide high-quality, evidence-based rehabilitation services across inpatient and ambulatory settings, supporting patients with complex medical and rehabilitation needs.
Key responsibilities include:
  • Providing specialist rehabilitation assessment and treatment
  • Leading and supervising an inpatient treating team
  • Supporting effective patient flow, admission and discharge planning
  • Working collaboratively with nursing, allied health and community services
  • Supervising Registrars, Principal House Officers and junior medical staff
  • Participating in undergraduate and postgraduate teaching
  • Contributing to clinical governance, quality improvement and research
  • Participating in after-hours and on-call services as required
Exceptional Remuneration and Benefits
A total remuneration package of up to $564,939 per annum is available, depending on experience and appointment level.
Additional benefits may include:
  • 12.75% employer superannuation
  • 3.6 weeks of professional development leave
  • Professional development allowance of $22,145 per annum
  • 17.5% annual leave loading
  • Motor vehicle allowance
  • Overtime and on-call allowances
  • Attraction and retention incentives
  • Granted private practice arrangements
  • Salary packaging
  • Relocation assistance
  • Initial accommodation, subject to conditions
  • Flexible working arrangements and excellent work-life balance
Essential Requirements
Applicants must hold:
  • Fellowship of the Australasian Faculty of Rehabilitation Medicine (FAFRM); or
  • An overseas specialist qualification assessed as substantially comparable in Rehabilitation Medicine
  • Eligibility for specialist registration with the Medical Board of Australia
How to Apply
For further information or a confidential discussion regarding this opportunity, please contact:

Nicki Wade
Senior Recruitment Consultant
M: +61 401 010 048
E: nickiw@ccjobs.com.au

About the roles

Join dedicated mental health teams delivering contemporary, recovery-focused care to children and adolescents up to 18 years experiencing severe and complex mental health conditions.

Working across inpatient and community settings, you will be part of a supportive multidisciplinary team providing comprehensive assessment, treatment and ongoing care tailored to each young person’s needs.

Enjoy excellent career development opportunities, a diverse range of professional experiences and the opportunity to make a lasting difference in the lives of young people and their families.

Experienced Hospital Physiotherapist required for this regional NSW service, close to gorgeous Yamba and Angourie! You must be available from 6th October – 6th November. The dates are not negotiable.

job.title: Specialist Emergency Medicine
job.description:
Specialist – Emergency Medicine | Tasmania
Exceptional package | Coastal lifestyle | Flexible rostering
Salary package up to $550k plus!!

International Emergency Medicine Specialists who have completed the ACEM specialist assessment process with substantial comparability outcome will be considered.
Are you seeking a senior Emergency Medicine role offering professional variety, genuine flexibility and an outstanding lifestyle?
An established regional health service on Tasmania’s spectacular coast is seeking experienced Specialists in Emergency Medicine and appropriately qualified Rural Generalists with advanced Emergency Medicine skills.

Multiple permanent full-time and part-time appointments are available, working up to 76 hours per fortnight, with shift work and on-call participation.
Why Make the Move?

Tasmania’s coast combines rewarding regional medicine with an enviable quality of life.
Enjoy pristine beaches, dramatic coastline, national parks, mountain biking, bushwalking and an outstanding paddock-to-plate food culture. The region offers welcoming communities, affordable living and space for families, while remaining highly accessible to mainland Australia.
Local airports provide convenient connections, with flights to Melbourne taking less than one hour.
This is an opportunity to build a fulfilling specialist career without sacrificing the time and freedom to enjoy life outside work.

The Opportunity
You will work across two well-supported Emergency Departments located approximately 50 kilometres apart, together managing around 60,000 presentations annually.
The larger site serves as the regional trauma centre and is supported by:
  • General Medicine
  • General Surgery
  • Orthopaedics
  • Paediatrics
  • Obstetrics and Gynaecology
  • Intensive Care
  • Mental Health services
  • 24-hour pathology
  • 24-hour on-call radiology
  • Virtual stroke telemedicine services
Each department has a structured medical workforce comprising Specialists, Registrars and Resident Medical Officers rostered to every shift.

Develop a Portfolio Around Your Interests
Join a welcoming and inclusive specialist team with expertise spanning:
  • Toxicology
  • Point-of-care ultrasound
  • Paediatric Emergency Medicine
  • Disaster and humanitarian medicine
  • Clinical research
  • Palliative care and voluntary assisted dying
  • Medical education
  • Clinical leadership and administration
You will be encouraged to develop a professional portfolio aligned with your interests while contributing to trainee supervision, education and service development.
Opportunities are also available to participate in emergency medicine outreach education across more remote communities.

Training and Accreditation
The service offers a strong teaching environment with accreditation for:
  • 24 months of ACEM Emergency Medicine training
  • RACGP Advanced Skills Training in Emergency Medicine
  • ACRRM Advanced Specialised Training in Emergency Medicine
  • ACEM Associateship training at Foundational, Intermediate and Advanced levels
The department supports trainees from ACEM, RACGP and ACRRM, with several FACEM-accredited supervisors available across the service.

Attractive Remuneration and Benefits
Salary packages up to $550k plus
Depending on eligibility, additional benefits may include:
  • 35% allowance in lieu of private practice
  • 20% recruitment and retention allowance
  • Employer superannuation contribution
  • Professional development allowance of up to $16,480 per annum
  • Fully maintained vehicle or allowance of up to $28,389 per annum
  • Three months of funded accommodation tailored to your family’s needs
  • Generous relocation assistance
  • Salary packaging of up to $9,010 for living expenses
  • Meal entertainment packaging of up to $2,650
  • Exceptionally flexible rostering arrangements
Essential Eligibility
Applicants must hold, or be eligible to obtain, specialist or limited registration with the Medical Board of Australia in a relevant specialty.
Applications are welcomed from:
  • FACEM-qualified Emergency Physicians
  • Suitably experienced RACGP or ACRRM Fellows with advanced Emergency Medicine qualifications
  • International Emergency Medicine Specialists who have completed the ACEM specialist assessment process with substantial comparability outcome
Important: Candidates requiring ACEM specialist assessment must provide their formal assessment outcome before they can be considered.

Take the Next Step
To learn more about this opportunity or arrange a confidential discussion, please contact:
Nicki Wade

job.title: Consultant Psychiatrist
job.description:
What’s on offer 
  • Package of $350,000 - $450,000 p.a. + generous relocation allowance
  • Job security, career growth, flexible work, and meaningful community impact
  • Supportive multidisciplinary team with a strong culture of collaboration
  • Thriving location offering beautiful waterfronts, nature and convenient access to Sydney
About the role

In this rewarding clinical leadership role within an adult inpatient unit, you will provide comprehensive psychiatric assessment, diagnosis, treatment planning and ongoing clinical care. Working collaboratively with a skilled multidisciplinary team, you will lead patient-centred care, support and supervise junior medical staff, and contribute to service development and continuous improvement. This is a valuable opportunity to make a meaningful difference to patients, their families and the wider community while delivering high-quality mental health care.

Relocating to Australia…… support we can offer you
  • Forget Government Job Boards - We know our hospitals. We provide you with exclusive Psychiatrist job vacancies and direct link-ups with Mental Health Dept. Directors
  • Our recruitment service is FREE and personalised to your career and location requirements
  • Psychiatrist Peer to Peer Group Support with the RANZCP Specialist Assessment and Medical Board Applications
  • All Job applications prepared and submitted by our recruitment team.
  • Support with enrolling your children into leading private or state-run schools
  • Registered Migration Agent advice and support
Sound like you

Contact Jonathan Richards, your Psychiatry Recruitment Specialist, to find out more about this role and all it has to offer.

Tel: 0422408729

Email: jonathanr@ccjobs.com.au

About Jonathan Richards

“I have 15+ years’ experience connecting Psychiatrists with the best job opportunities across Australia. It is my passion and privilege to ensure you are being provided with the best recruitment services available.”

job.title: Head of Unit – Obstetrics & Gynaecology
job.description:
Head of Unit – Obstetrics & Gynaecology
Regional South Australia | Within Easy Reach of Adelaide
  • Indicative Total Remuneration: $355,428–$509,367 per annum
  • Additional managerial allowance of $10,333 per annum
  • Ongoing, full-time Consultant appointment
  • Initial three-year appointment as Head of Unit
  • Combine senior clinical practice with genuine service leadership
Shape the Future of a Growing Women’s Health Service
An exciting opportunity is available for an experienced Specialist Obstetrician and Gynaecologist to lead a growing Obstetrics and Gynaecology service within a progressive South Australian regional health network.

The Location
Enjoy the professional benefits of regional medicine without feeling disconnected from city life. It is an ideal location for clinicians and families seeking greater space, a more relaxed lifestyle and meaningful professional opportunities without relocating to a remote area.
The hospital is situated within easy reach of Adelaide, allowing access to metropolitan amenities, an international airport, universities, excellent schools and major cultural and sporting events.

The surrounding region offers:
  • A relaxed and welcoming community.
  • More affordable housing than central metropolitan areas.
  • Easy access to renowned food and wine destinations.
  • Excellent local produce, restaurants and weekend markets.
  • Open spaces, walking trails and outdoor recreation.
  • A family-friendly lifestyle with a manageable commute.
  • The opportunity to enjoy regional living while maintaining strong links with Adelaide.
Based at a busy regional hospital serving one of the state’s fastest-growing communities, this position offers the rare combination of clinical variety, leadership autonomy and regional practice while remaining conveniently connected to metropolitan Adelaide.

As Head of Unit, you will provide strategic and clinical leadership across antenatal, labour and birth, postnatal and gynaecology services. You will also have protected time to lead service development, clinical governance, quality improvement and workforce initiatives.

The Hospital
This expanding regional health service provides an increasingly broad and complex range of specialist, acute and community-based services.
Continued population growth is creating increased demand for maternity and women’s health services, offering the incoming Head of Unit a genuine opportunity to influence future models of care, develop clinical capability and support the sustainable growth of the department.

You will join a committed and supportive multidisciplinary team with strong connections across hospital, community and primary care services. The organisation has a clear focus on safe, compassionate and collaborative care, alongside staff development, innovation and improved access to services.

This is an opportunity to become part of a hospital entering an important phase of growth—not simply maintaining an established service but helping determine what it becomes.

Your Role
As Head of Unit, you will:
  • Provide strategic and clinical leadership for Obstetrics and Gynaecology services.
  • Deliver high-quality specialist care across maternity and gynaecology.
  • Lead, mentor and support medical and multidisciplinary staff.
  • Promote a culture of collaboration, accountability and professional development.
  • Drive service innovation, clinical governance and quality improvement.
  • Support safe, contemporary and evidence-based models of care.
  • Contribute to workforce planning and sustainable service growth.
  • Develop strong relationships across the health network and wider community.
  • Support teaching, supervision and the development of junior medical staff.
  • Improve access and outcomes for women, babies and families across the region.
What Is Offered?
  • Indicative Total Remuneration of $355,428–$509,367 per annum.
  • Additional $10,333 annual managerial allowance.
  • Ongoing full-time employment as a consultant.
  • Initial three-year Head of Unit appointment.
  • A balanced clinical and leadership portfolio.
  • Protected time for leadership, service development and professional activities.
  • Significant professional autonomy and influence.
  • Generous leave provisions.
  • Professional development opportunities and allowances.
  • Private practice arrangements, where applicable.
  • Employee Assistance Program access for you and your family.
  • Health and wellbeing benefits, including access to a discounted fitness program.
The total remuneration package may include award salary, managerial and remote-call allowances, professional development, attraction and retention allowances, superannuation and applicable private practice arrangements.

About You
We are seeking an accomplished Obstetrician and Gynaecologist who offers:
  • Broad clinical expertise across obstetrics and gynaecology.
  • Demonstrated clinical leadership or service-management experience.
  • A commitment to clinical excellence, governance and patient safety.
  • The ability to lead and develop high-performing multidisciplinary teams.
  • A collaborative, approachable and inclusive leadership style.
  • An interest in teaching, mentoring and workforce development.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement and communication skills.
  • A commitment to culturally safe and patient-centred care.
Essential Requirements
Applicants must hold:
  • An MBBS or equivalent medical qualification.
  • Appropriate specialist qualifications in Obstetrics and Gynaecology.
  • Specialist registration, or eligibility for specialist registration, with the Medical Board of Australia in Obstetrics and Gynaecology.
The successful applicant will also be required to satisfy the relevant credentialling, immunisation and pre-employment screening requirements.

Confidential Enquiries
For a confidential discussion or further information, please contact:

Nicki Wade
Senior Recruitment Consultant
CC Medical
Phone: 0401 010 048
Email: nickiw@ccjobs.com.au

Please submit your current CV together with a cover letter outlining your clinical leadership experience and suitability for this appointment.
This is an exceptional opportunity to lead a growing service, influence its future direction and enjoy a rewarding regional lifestyle within easy reach of Adelaide.

job.title: Consultant Physician – General Medicine with Special Interest
job.description:
Consultant Physician – General Medicine with Special Interest
Regional Victoria | Approximately 2.5 hours from Melbourne
Specialist Year 1–9 | Permanent opportunity
Salary packaging and professional development benefits

An excellent opportunity is available for a Consultant Physician to join a welcoming regional health service in one of Victoria’s most naturally beautiful and affordable regions.
This position would suit a General Physician with a special interest such as Endocrinology, Diabetes, Respiratory Medicine, Cardiology, Geriatric Medicine or another complementary subspecialty. You will have the opportunity to develop your area of interest while contributing to a broad and professionally rewarding general medicine service.

An outstanding regional lifestyle
Enjoy the space, affordability and relaxed pace of regional living while remaining within convenient reach of Melbourne.
The region provides exceptional access to:
  • The Gippsland Lakes and extensive coastal waterways
  • Ninety Mile Beach
  • Alpine areas and national parks
  • Boating, fishing, hiking, cycling and water sports
  • Award-winning food, wineries and local produce
  • Quality schools and family-friendly communities
  • More affordable housing and shorter daily commutes
This is an attractive opportunity for a physician seeking a genuine work–life balance without sacrificing clinical variety, professional development or career progression.

The opportunity
You will join a collaborative multidisciplinary team providing high-quality care across acute inpatient, ambulatory and community settings.
The role offers:
  • A varied and interesting General Medicine caseload
  • Scope to establish or expand a subspecialty service
  • Participation in rapid-access and general medical clinics
  • Opportunities to contribute to Hospital in the Home
  • Senior clinical leadership across the Medical Services Division
  • Supervision and mentoring of physician trainees, junior doctors and medical students
  • Involvement in clinical governance, quality improvement and service development
  • Potential career progression into clinical leadership positions
  • Support from experienced consultants and multidisciplinary clinical teams
The position participates in the physician on-call roster, providing senior support to the Emergency Department, Critical Care Unit and inpatient services.

The health service
This established subregional health service is the principal provider of acute, community and residential aged care services across a significant regional catchment.

Its major hospital campus provides:
  • A 24-hour Emergency Department
  • Critical care and coronary care services
  • General medical and surgical inpatient units
  • Cardiology, respiratory medicine and oncology services
  • Renal dialysis
  • Operating theatres and surgical services
  • Specialist outpatient clinics
  • Maternity, neonatal and paediatric care
  • Community rehabilitation and Hospital in the Home services
The Medical Services Division is supported by experienced consultants, physician trainees, junior medical officers, nursing staff and a broad multidisciplinary allied health team.

Essential requirements
Applicants must hold:
  • Medical qualifications eligible for registration with the Medical Board of Australia
  • Fellowship of the Royal Australasian College of Physicians, or an equivalent specialist qualification
  • Demonstrated experience managing complex acute and chronic medical conditions
  • Strong communication, teamwork and clinical leadership skills
  • A commitment to patient-centred care, teaching and continuous improvement
Take the next step
If you are a General Physician looking to combine rewarding clinical practice with an exceptional regional lifestyle, we would welcome the opportunity to speak with you.

Select Apply Now to submit your current CV, or contact Nicki for a confidential discussion:
Nicki Wade
Senior Recruitment Consultant – CC Medical
Email: nickiw@ccjobs.com.au
Phone: 0401 010 048

job.title: Hospital Social Worker
job.description:
• Long term contract – 6-12 months ++
  • Flights covered + FREE accommodation
  • $95,697-$114,104 per annum + superannuation

Experienced Social Worker required for this NT service. This is a remote 60 bed hospital. The service requires high level skills and demonstrated cultural competence working respectfully with Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander population. There is a high incidence of domestic and family violence, child neglect and abuse reporting and statutory child removal. 
 
Long term contract – 6-12 months ++ or permanent if preferred.
 
We are looking for an applicant with hospital-based experience including experience in an emergency department and general medicine wards, complex caseload management, and ability to work autonomously and within an MDT. Desirable skills also include experience working with Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islanders, regional or remote hospital experience and ability to work rostered weekends.
 
 

I’ve had great feedback from the 50+ allied health locums I’ve placed here over the years. To be considered, you must have:
 
  • Experience NOT including placements providing clinical social work services within a hospital setting (Emergency Department), including crisis intervention and short term support
  • Strong knowledge and experience in domestic and family violence risk assessment, safety planning and support services
  • Experience working with child protection concerns, including mandatory reporting requirements, and liaising with relevant agencies
  • Ability to work extended hours, including weekends and after-hours shifts, on call (penalty rates apply)
  • This role is NOT suitable for new graduates or candidates who don't have PAID hospital experience
 
Cases include:
  • Sexual violence
  • ED presentations
  • Crisis response (adults and paediatrics)
  • Guardianship
  • Advocacy
  • NDIS applications
  • Inpatients only – ED, acute wards – general medical, surgical, palliative care, rehabilitation, maternity and paediatrics
  • You must have strong crisis response and experience with victims of domestic and sexual violence
  • Join a team of clinicians at different levels from Director, Team leaders, SWs, DTs, OTs, PTs, SPs, AHAs, ALOs, Admin 

You must have relevant experience.

This role requires you to be eligible for AASW membership.

Overseas trained Social Workers, please do not respond unless your qualifications have been assessed by the AASW.
 
Join my other locums who love this remote health service!
 
Travel reimbursed + accommodation provided.

A driving license is required for this role.
 
This is a P2 level role, the salary range is $95,697-$114,104 per annum + superannuation. Experienced P1 level candidates welcome to apply.
 
Come to where the Outback meets the tropics and discover a region full of gorges and misty waterfalls, thermal springs and ancient cultures. This region is a nature lovers paradise.
 
 

To apply for this role or to enquire about our other vacancies, please contact Rachael – Allied Health Division Lead at CC Medical on 0452 189 556 or email rachaeld@ccjobs.com.au


My contactable days are Monday – Friday. If you need to contact me over the weekend, please send an email.
