job.description:
Experienced Podiatrists required for locums across Australia - please see a small sample of the current vacancies below:

Coastal South Australia - Locum Podiatrist/Senior Podiatrist
  • August/September start for 12 weeks ++
  • Outpatients, high risk feet, complex wound care
  • Locum rates & FREE accommodation + travel
Experienced Podiatrists required for role with regional health service, located approximately seven hours drive from Adelaide (there is also an airport in town). You’ll join a medium size allied health team. The role is to start ASAP. 12 weeks ++ in duration.
 
 
Your caseload will cover:
  • Rural generalist caseload. Caseload is predominately outpatients, but includes some inpatients, aged care and paediatrics. May be opportunities for outreach to rural/ remote communities. Caseload would be allocated as per experience.
  • You will be proficient in high risk wound care but would be working in a rural generalist role servicing clients across the age spectrum and across clinical priorities and programs.
  • Regional/ rural experience preferred - working with Aboriginal consumers, high risk wound experience.
  • Sunrise experience preferred for clinical documentation needs
  • You will be working in the local community. A car is provided for work purposes. The role will be Monday – Friday, 37.5 hours per week.
  • Free accommodation provided
  • Competitive locum rates in line with experience – PAYG + option for living away from home tax benefits or ABN (up to $100 per hour)
 
The Eyre and Far North covers almost 440,000 square kilometres of spectacular South Australia, supporting about 40,000 people living around Eyre Peninsula and the Far North of the state.
 
With its ancient outback landscapes and culture, boutique vineyards, renowned oyster farms and Australia’s best-kept-secret surf coast, the Eyre Peninsula and Far North offers a lifestyle that will inspire and energise you. The region enjoys a Mediterranean style climate so there’s plenty of opportunity to enjoy everything the region has to offer. From surfing and fishing to hiking and exploring the outback – create your best life, right here.
 
 
 
 
 
Townsville, sunny QLD - Locum Podiatrist
  • ASAP start for 4-12 weeks + possible extension
  • Locum rates $$ + car provided
  • Community and outreach
Locum Podiatrist required for a role in sunny Townsville. I’ve had great feedback from other locums. You will join a team of allied health clinicians.
  • The caseload is generalist position covering outreach communities of Charters Towers, Collinsville, Bowen, Ayr/Home Hill, Ingham
  • Predominantly working with community-based aged care clients- no nursing homes; diabetes foot assessments, primary care
  • Monday – Friday. The hours are flexible to account for time spent travelling to outreach sites.
  • No accommodation available
  • All travel amongst sites covered using fleet cars
 
Additional Information:
  • August/September for 4-12 weeks + longer term options also available.
  • Locum rates based on experience, more for ABN!
  • Potential for PAYG living away from home benefits (more take home pay, usually $5-7 dollars more an hour!).
  • A car is provided for work travel between sites.
 
Escape winter in sunny Townsville. Enjoy a tropical climate, thriving water sports scene including diving, snorkelling, boating, fishing, kayaking. Explore the neighbouring islands and Great Barrier Reef, enjoy endless sunshine, national parks, hikes and waterfalls and a bustling city centre.
 
 
 
 
 
 
Remote QLD - 2 x Locum Podiatrist – remote health and outreach
  • ASAP start for 8-12 weeks + possible extension
  • Locum rates $$ + accommodation and travel provided
  • Community and outreach
2 x Locum Podiatrists required for locum roles in Outback Queensland. I’ve had great feedback from other locums. You will join a team of allied health clinicians and cover:
  • Initial assessments and reviews
  • Diabetic foot assessments
  • General nail care and treatment
  • Biomechanical and orthotics
  • A generalist caseload predominantly for low to moderate risk clients
  • Outreach involving road and sometimes aircraft with overnight travel. The multidisciplinary team provides outreach to communities in the area
  • Indigenous and Torres Strait Islander population as well as general population
  • Monday – Friday. The hours are flexible to account for time spent travelling to outreach sites.
  • There are two locations available.
 
Additional Information:
  • August/September for 8-12 weeks + longer term options also available.
  • Locum rates based on experience, more for ABN.
  • Potential for PAYG living away from home benefits (more take home pay, usually $5-7 dollars more an hour!).
  • FREE accommodation, a private room in a share house. There may or may not be other occupants depending on timing. A car is also provided for local use.
  • Return flights reimbursed.
Are you ready to experience Outback Australia?
 
 
 
 
 
 
Regional SA - Locum Podiatrist/Senior Podiatrist 
  • August/September start for three months ++
  • Outpatients, high risk feet, complex wound care
  • Locum rates & FREE accommodation + travel
Experienced Podiatrists required for role with regional health service, located approximately four hours from Adelaide. You’ll join a medium size allied health team. The role is to start ASAP. Three months ++ in duration.
 
There are several vacancies across two locations. Open to AHP 1, 2 or 3 level options.
 
Your caseload will cover:
  • Rural generalist caseload. Caseload is predominately outpatients, but includes some inpatients, aged care and paediatrics. May be opportunities for outreach to rural/ remote communities. Caseload would be allocated as per experience.
  • You will be will be proficient in high risk wound care (with 30-40 active high-risk wound patients at the site) but would be working in a rural generalist role servicing clients across the age spectrum and across clinical priorities and programs.
  • Regional/ rural experience preferred - working with Aboriginal consumers, high risk wound experience.
  • Join a multi-disciplinary team including OT, PT, SP, SW, O&P, DT. The Podiatrists work closely with Diabetes Educators, Orthotics & Prosthetics and Wound Nurse. The Podiatry department will soon consistent of 3 contractor/ FIFO staff.
  • You will be working in the local community. A car is provided for work purposes. The role will be Monday – Friday, 37.5 hours per week.
  • Free accommodation provided
  • Upto $500 reimbursed for travel (with receipts)
  • Competitive locum rates in line with experience – PAYG + option for living away from home tax benefits or ABN (up to $100 per hour)
 
I’ve placed many locums with this service over the years and the feedback is positive. The team are young and inclusive.
 
 
Located on Eyre Peninsula’s Spencer Gulf in South Australia, this region is an important hub and the region’s biggest city for retail shopping. The location boasts a warm climate, accessible ocean shores and saltwater fishing. It represents South Australia’s foremost combination of industrial and nature-based experiences. With vivid scenery, small city charm, distinctive mystic outback landscapes and year-round things to do.
 
 
 
 
 
Regional VIC - Podiatrist – regional health service
  • Rural Generalist inc:  outpatients & community
  • Travel + accommodation available
  • Locum rates up to $80 PAYG/$100 ABN
Experienced Podiatrist required for locum based in regional Victoria. The role is to start 31st August, flexible duration for locums - minimum 8 weeks required.
 
You will work alongside a small allied health team. This generalist caseload will cover:
  • A mixed caseload of clients from 0-100 years
  • Working across outpatients, community, a small amount of aged care & outreach
  • You will work alongside a team of other allied health professionals on the team including OT, Physiotherapist, Exercise Physiologist, Speech Pathologists, Dietitian, Qualified Social Worker, Health Promotion Officer and Allied Health Assistants
 
FREE accommodation available and locum rates up to $80 + super PAYG/$100 ABN. Travel reimbursement also available.
 
I’ve had great feedback from previous locums! There is also a permanent opportunity available. Minimum one year experience required.
 
Working in regional Australia offers the chance to work within close knit communities. As part of smaller teams, you will access a wider range of patients and develop your clinical expertise. These roles offer great rates of pay, accommodation and the chance to broaden your skill set within a range of healthcare settings.
 
 
 
 
 
Gorgeous regional VIC location - Podiatrist - 6-12 month contract
  • 2.5 hours from Melbourne
  • 6-12 months in duration
Join this lovely regional health service based in Victoria, just two and a half hours from Melbourne. A great team, my other candidates have loved this service. 
 
The role involves the provision of podiatry services to clients across the service areas, including community outpatients, acute, subacute, residential aged care and outreach services. The role focuses on providing appropriate services in the right setting, increasing the knowledge and skills of individuals in the community around foot health and mobility, delivery safe and comprehensive podiatric services to our high-risk clients and encourage where appropriate individuals to self-manage their own foot health while promoting health and wellbeing for all clients. Fixed term contract. No accommodation available
 
Join this lovely regional tourism hot spot based in Victoria, just two and a half from Melbourne. A great team, my other candidates have loved this service.
 
 

 

 
 
Working in regional Australia offers the chance to work within close knit communities. As part of smaller teams, you will access a wider range of patients and develop your clinical expertise. These roles offer great rates of pay, accommodation and the chance to broaden your skill set within a range of healthcare settings.



To apply for this role or to enquire about our other vacancies, please contact Rachael – Allied Health Division Lead at CC Medical on 0452 189 556 or email rachaeld@ccjobs.com.au



My contactable days are Monday – Friday. If you need to contact me over the weekend, please send an email.

job.title: Locum Hospital Speech Pathologist/Senior Speech Pathologist
job.description:
• 7th September for approx. one month
  • Upto $80 per hour + tax benefits – upto $8 extra per hour!
  • Accommodation + travel

 
 
Experienced Speech Pathologist required for a hospital based in North Queensland. You will work alongside a multidisciplinary team of allied health staff.
  • Hours would be 0800-1630 Monday to Friday with 1 hour unpaid break (7.5 hours per day)
  • Working across a rural generalist caseload including inpatient and outpatient caseloads across the lifespan, paediatrics to adults.
  • Working amongst the multidisciplinary team which is young and dynamic. The team regularly plan weekend adventures including camping, rodeos, and local events like wine festivals, balls, markets, and sporting events. We even hold an Allied Health Ball every year to celebrate all Allied Health Clinicians in North West Queensland. We have a few gyms in town including a yoga studio, Anytime Fitness, Pilates studio, a public pool and plenty of outdoor walking areas. There are cafes, a library, Kmart, Woolies and Coles, Harvey Norman, and a couple of specialty stores. The area is surrounded by cattle stations and you can even feed some camels just down the road from the Hospital! There’s a large freshwater lake 10km out of town where people regularly paddleboard, water ski, swim, and kayak to get their water fix, and there’s lots of water holes/water falls that can be visited after wet season to keep cool.
  • There are daily flights to Brisbane and Townsville and some direct flights throughout the week to Cairns.
    The rural and remote lifestyle often has some surprising perks and the opportunities both professionally and personally are great.
  • Locum rates upto $80 per hour + super + option for living away from home tax benefits – more take home pay upto $8 per hour
  • Accommodation can be provided for the length of contract
  • Up to $1000 (incl. GST) will be reimbursed for one way travel
 
 
You must be an experienced Speech Pathologist with the relevant skill set. A minimum of three years relevant experience is required.


This region offers a real insight into Outback Australia, with a wide range of places to enjoy 4 wheel driving, camping, fishing and hiking. A great location for any intrepid explorer!

 
To apply for this role or to enquire about our other vacancies, please contact Rachael – Allied Health Division Lead at CC Medical on 0452 189 556 or email rachaeld@ccjobs.com.au

 
My contactable days are Monday – Friday. If you need to contact me over the weekend, please send an email.

job.title: Consultant/Specialist Paediatrician
job.description:
Consultant/Specialist Paediatrician
Live and Work in Tropical Northern Australia
  • Remuneration package up to $420K+
  • Substantially comparable SIMGs considered
  • Expedited Specialist Pathway applicants welcomed
  • Exceptional clinical variety, teaching and remote outreach
An exciting opportunity is available for a Consultant Paediatrician to join a supportive and highly experienced Women’s, Children and Youth team at a leading tertiary hospital in tropical Northern Australia.

LIFESTYLE LIKE NOWHERE ELSE
Enjoy a tropical outdoor lifestyle with warm weather, spectacular sunsets and more time for life outside work.
  • No long commutes
  • Excellent fishing, boating and outdoor activities
  • Easy access to Kakadu and Litchfield national parks
  • A welcoming, close-knit medical community
  • Diverse cultural, dining and community experiences
  • An ideal base from which to explore northern Australia and Southeast Asia
This is an opportunity to combine meaningful specialist practice and career development with an adventurous lifestyle and genuine work-life balance.

REMUNERATION AND SUPPORT
  • Remuneration package up to $420K+
  • Relocation assistance may be available
  • Employer-sponsored visa support for eligible applicants
  • Guidance with specialist assessment, AHPRA registration and immigration processes
This position offers exposure to one of Australia’s most varied and rewarding general paediatric practices, providing specialist care across tertiary, regional and remote health services.

THE OPPORTUNITY
You will manage a broad and clinically stimulating caseload across acute, general, developmental and behavioural paediatrics.
The service provides:
  • General paediatric and adolescent inpatient care
  • Neonatal intensive care and retrieval services
  • General and specialist outpatient clinics
  • Outreach services to regional hospitals and remote communities
  • Care for children and families from culturally diverse backgrounds
  • Teaching and supervision of paediatric trainees, junior doctors and medical students
Clinical presentations range from common childhood illnesses to complex conditions more prevalent across tropical, rural and remote communities, including bronchiectasis, rheumatic heart disease, malnutrition and infectious diseases.
You will also contribute to clinical governance, service development, research, quality improvement and postgraduate education.

ABOUT YOU
To be considered, you will have:
  • FRACP in Paediatrics and specialist registration with AHPRA; or
  • An overseas specialist qualification assessed as substantially comparable; or
  • Eligibility to apply through Australia’s Expedited Specialist Pathway
  • Experience in acute and general paediatrics
  • Strong communication, teamwork and clinical leadership skills
  • An interest in teaching, research and continuous quality improvement
  • A commitment to improving Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander health outcomes
  • The ability to work effectively within a culturally diverse environment
TO APPLY
If this opportunity aligns with your experience and career goals, we would be pleased to hear from you.
Please send through your current CV, together with details of your specialist qualifications and current registration status. All enquiries will be handled in confidence.

Nicki Wade
Senior Medical Recruitment Consultant
nickiw@ccjobs.com.au
+61 401 010 048

job.title: Locum Senior Hospital Dietitian
job.description:
• 7th September for 8 weeks
  • Accommodation available + travel assistance
  • Upto $80 per hour + super + tax benefits
  • Living away from home tax benefits – upto $8 extra per hour!

 
Experienced Dietitian required for hospital based role in the Northern Territory. You will join team of 100 allied health clinicians, including Occupational Therapists, Podiatrists, Physiotherapists, Speech Pathologists, Dietitians, Social Workers, Chaplain, ALO. I’ve had great feedback from my current locums.
 
  • 7th September for 8 weeks
  • Acute care or renal experience required
  • The caseload is acute care- ICU, paediatrics, renal, surgical general medical and outpatients, gastro- including PEG and IBD. A lot of opportunities for unique experiences and professional development including eating disorders, motivational interviewing and cultural engagement.
  • Team leadership experience preferred
  • Locum rates upto $80 per hour + super
  • Option for living away from home tax benefits – more take home pay upto $8 per hour
  • ABN payment also an option!
  • Hospital experience is mandatory
  • You need to have or be eligible for Accredited Practising Dietitian (APD) status.
  • Work hours are 8am to 4.21pm
  • Driver’s licence is preferred but not essential.
  • Opportunity for remote trips if desired
  • The team is very social.
  • Relocation assistance of upto $1000 and subsidised accommodation available. The accommodation is on site, so less than 5 min to walk to work and 10 minutes to town.

Join this large allied health team, including some of my other locums. All have extended their time with this hospital. The team are inclusive and social.

85% of the caseload is indigenous, with 50% coming in from remote communities. I’ve had great feedback from my current locums and this is a great chance to develop your skill set. If you like the outdoors, the lifestyle here is fab! 

The location is a great base for exploring the natural wonders of the Outback including: Uluru, Kata Tjuta, Kings Canyon, the West MacDonnell Ranges and the Larapinta Trail, the Simpson Desert and the gorgeous NT watering holes. It’s also a fascinating spot to explore Australia’s Aboriginal culture.

Working in regional Australia offers the chance to work within close knit communities. As part of smaller teams, you will access a wider range of patients and develop your clinical expertise. These roles offer great rates of pay, accommodation and the chance to broaden your skill set within a range of healthcare settings.

job.title: Consultant Obstetrician & Gynaecologist – Coastal Tasmania
job.description:
Consultant Obstetrician & Gynaecologist – Coastal Tasmania
Permanent Full-Time | Salary Package up to $647,306 | Exceptional Coastal Lifestyle
An outstanding opportunity is available for an experienced Consultant Obstetrician & Gynaecologist to join a highly regarded regional health service in coastal Tasmania.
Offering an exceptional remuneration package, broad clinical scope and genuine work–life balance, this role provides the opportunity to deliver high-quality specialist care while enjoying one of Australia’s most desirable coastal lifestyles.

The Opportunity
This permanent full-time appointment offers the opportunity to work within a comprehensive regional Obstetrics and Gynaecology service, providing specialist care across inpatient, outpatient and procedural settings.
The position is available for up to 76 hours per fortnight, with working arrangements open to negotiation.
You will join a supportive multidisciplinary team and contribute to clinical education, service development and improving healthcare outcomes across the region.

The Department
The Obstetrics and Gynaecology Department provides comprehensive regional services supported by:
  • Approximately 1,000 births annually
  • Level 4 maternity and neonatal services
  • Eight-bed Intensive Care Unit
  • Experienced midwives and a highly regarded Midwifery Group Practice
  • Antenatal and gynaecology outreach services
  • University-affiliated undergraduate and postgraduate teaching opportunities
  • Opportunities to influence service development and regional healthcare delivery
  • Supportive multidisciplinary and specialist teams
  • Typical after-hours roster of approximately 1:5 weekdays and weekends
Remuneration and Benefits
  • Total remuneration package up to $647,306
  • Indicative package range approximately $465,112–$647,306
  • 12% superannuation
  • 20% regional recruitment and retention allowance
  • 35% private practice scheme participation or allowance in lieu
  • Fully maintained private-plated vehicle or motor vehicle allowance of $28,786
  • Continuing Professional Development allowance of $17,483
  • Generous salary packaging benefits
  • Relocation and travel assistance
  • Study leave and professional development support
  • Comprehensive leave entitlements
The Location
Located in coastal Tasmania, this vibrant regional city offers an exceptional lifestyle surrounded by dramatic coastline, pristine beaches, mountains and national parks.
This is an opportunity to enjoy:
  • A more balanced lifestyle with shorter commute times
  • More attainable housing compared with major capital cities
  • Excellent schools, sporting facilities and welcoming communities
  • Easy access to walking trails, waterfalls, wineries, farmers’ markets and some of Australia’s most celebrated wilderness destinations
Despite its peaceful setting, the region remains well connected. The nearest airport is approximately 20 minutes from the hospital and offers direct flights to a major mainland capital in around 70 minutes. A second regional airport approximately 40 minutes away provides additional travel options.

About You
You will hold:
  • Current AHPRA specialist registration or limited registration
  • Fellowship of the relevant specialist college or equivalent qualifications
  • Demonstrated experience in Obstetrics and Gynaecology
  • Commitment to multidisciplinary care, teaching and service improvement
This is an exciting opportunity to develop a rewarding specialist career while enjoying the lifestyle benefits of coastal Tasmania.

How to Apply
For a confidential discussion or to apply, please contact:
Nicki Wade
Senior Medical Recruitment Consultant
 nickiw@ccjobs.com.au
+61401 010 048

job.title: Consultant Anaesthetist
job.description:
Consultant Anaesthetist
Permanent Part-Time (0.75 FTE) | Regional South Australia | Indicative Total Remuneration up to $756,662 p.a. (pro rata)
An exciting permanent opportunity is available for a Consultant Anaesthetist to join a well-established regional health service in South Australia.

This 0.75 FTE position offers a varied scope of contemporary anaesthetic practice across surgical, obstetric and critical care services, together with opportunities to contribute to teaching, clinical governance and service development.
A convenient regional airport offers regular direct flights to both Adelaide and Melbourne, making interstate travel and visits from family and friends easy.

The location is a thriving regional centre offering an excellent balance between professional opportunity and quality of life. It provides the amenities required for comfortable family living while retaining the affordability, space and sense of community that are increasingly difficult to find in larger cities.

For doctors relocating from the UK or a metropolitan centre, the region offers the space and lifestyle benefits of regional Australia without sacrificing essential services, education, recreation or connectivity.

Lifestyle advantages include:
  • More affordable housing, with opportunities for larger homes and land
  • Shorter commutes and more time outside work
  • A relaxed, welcoming and family-friendly community
  • Access to TAFE and university education
  • Quality cafés, restaurants and outstanding local produce
  • Internationally recognised wineries and food experiences
  • Beautiful coastline, safe beaches and recreational fishing
  • National parks, walking trails, caves and outdoor adventures
  • Strong sporting clubs, community groups and cultural activities
  • A convenient position between two major Australian capital cities
Applicants should hold:
  • FANZCA or an equivalent specialist qualification
  • Eligibility for Specialist Registration with AHPRA
Internationally trained anaesthetists who have been assessed as Substantially Comparable or meet the Expedited Specialist Pathway are also encouraged to enquire.
The department is led by a new Director with extensive UK and Australian experience, who is building an innovative, progressive and supportive team culture. This is an excellent opportunity to join the department at an exciting stage of its development and have genuine input into the future direction of the service.

Remuneration and benefits
A highly competitive remuneration package is available, including:
  • Permanent Part-Time (0.75 FTE) appointment working over a 7-day roster
  • Indicative total remuneration of up to $756,662 p.a. (pro rata)
  • Relocation reimbursement
  • Supportive and forward-thinking departmental leadership
  • Broad surgical and obstetric anaesthetic practice
  • Opportunities to influence service development and clinical practice
  • Teaching, mentoring, research and quality-improvement opportunities
  • A collaborative multidisciplinary working environment
  • An attractive regional lifestyle with considerably less commuting
Apply now
Take the next step in your career and join a progressive regional health service offering excellent clinical variety, professional development and an outstanding lifestyle.

job.title: Consultant/Specialist – Obstetrics & Gynaecology
job.description:
Consultant/Specialist – Obstetrics & Gynaecology
Regional Queensland | 90 Minutes from Brisbane | Package up to $481,935 + Super
IMG’s eligible for expedited pathway or RANZCOG assessed as substantially comparable with be considered.

An excellent opportunity is available for a Consultant/Specialist in Obstetrics and Gynaecology to join a major accredited teaching hospital within easy reach of Brisbane.
You will provide comprehensive specialist care while contributing to clinical leadership, education and the continued development of women’s health services across a large and diverse regional community.

The position
Working within a supportive multidisciplinary team, you will:
  • Deliver high-quality obstetric and gynaecological care across inpatient, outpatient and procedural settings.
  • Manage a varied clinical caseload and support safe, coordinated patient care.
  • Provide clinical leadership, supervision and education to junior medical staff.
  • Participate in quality improvement, clinical governance and service development.
  • Promote evidence-based practice and positive healthcare outcomes for women and families.
  • Support the delivery of services to surrounding rural communities.
The lifestyle
Enjoy the space and affordability of regional living without losing convenient access to Brisbane.
This modern city offers:
  • Excellent public and private schools
  • Two universities and vocational education providers
  • Affordable housing and short commutes
  • Restaurants, galleries, museums and excellent shopping
  • Extensive sporting and recreational facilities
  • A temperate climate with four distinct seasons
  • A welcoming, family-friendly community
This is an outstanding opportunity to progress your career, take on meaningful clinical leadership responsibilities and enjoy a genuine work-life balance.

The hospital and health service
The principal hospital is a 364-bed accredited teaching and regional referral centre. It forms part of an integrated health network providing services to approximately 300,000 people across 29 facilities.
The broader network includes:
  • A major regional referral hospital
  • Three regional hub hospitals
  • Twelve rural hospitals
  • An extended inpatient mental health service
  • Three multipurpose health services
  • Community outpatient clinics
  • Residential aged-care facilities
  • Comprehensive acute, mental health, aged-care, community and allied health services
Remuneration and benefits
A competitive remuneration package valued at up to $481,935 is available, including:
  • Motor vehicle allowance
  • Regional attraction allowance
  • Professional development allowance
  • 3.6 weeks of professional development leave annually
  • Private practice arrangements
  • Professional indemnity cover
  • Salary packaging
  • Flexible working arrangements
  • Fitness Passport and employee wellbeing benefits
Superannuation of up to 12.75% and annual leave loading of 17.5% are payable in addition to the total remuneration package.

Essential requirements
Applicants should hold:
  • Specialist registration with the Medical Board of Australia in Obstetrics and Gynaecology; or
  • Qualifications and experience eligible for specialist registration or an approved equivalent pathway
Experience supporting rural health services, teaching junior doctors or contributing to service development would be highly regarded.
This is an outstanding opportunity to progress your career, take on meaningful clinical leadership responsibilities and enjoy a genuine work-life balance.

How to Apply
If you're ready to take the next step in your career, we'd love to hear from you.

Senior Recruitment Consultant – Permanent Doctors

job.title: Medical Oncology | Advanced Trainee / CMO / Senior Medical Practitioner
job.description:
Advanced Trainee / Career Medical Officer (CMO) / Senior Medical Practitioner (SMP) | Salary Package up to $220,000
Regional NSW - Outstanding Training | Award-Winning Research | No On-Call | Exceptional Work-Life Balance

Are you looking to advance your career in Medical Oncology within a highly regarded multidisciplinary cancer centre that combines outstanding clinical exposure, research excellence and an enviable lifestyle?
We are seeking an Advanced Trainee, Career Medical Officer (CMO) or Senior Medical Practitioner (SMP) to join a comprehensive regional cancer service based within a major 300-bed Rural Referral Hospital. Bringing together Medical Oncology, Haematology and Radiation Oncology under one roof, this modern service delivers exceptional patient care while providing outstanding opportunities for professional development.

Why Families Love Living Here
This thriving regional city offers everything you need for an exceptional quality of life. Families benefit from a wide choice of high-quality public, Catholic and independent schools, including selective academic programs, making it an excellent place to raise children. The city is also home to tertiary education options and strong pathways for ongoing learning.

Despite its regional setting, you'll enjoy excellent connectivity with multiple daily flights to Sydney, regular coach and rail services, and easy road access to major centres, making travel for work or visiting family simple and convenient. Public transport and school bus networks service the surrounding suburbs and regional communities, making commuting straightforward for families.

With short commute times and a welcoming community, you'll have more time to enjoy life outside the hospital.

The Opportunity
You'll become part of a collaborative and supportive oncology team comprising experienced Consultant Medical Oncologists, dedicated junior medical staff and specialist nursing teams. Working across outpatient and inpatient services, you'll gain broad experience in systemic therapies, multidisciplinary cancer management and complex oncology care.
This is an exceptional opportunity to work in a service that values education, mentorship and clinical excellence while maintaining an excellent work-life balance with no after-hours on-call commitment.

Why You'll Love This Role
  • Accredited Medical Oncology Advanced Training position
  • Four dedicated outpatient clinics each week
  • Comprehensive exposure to inpatient and outpatient oncology
  • Structured consultant supervision and formal teaching
  • Supervise and mentor junior medical staff
  • Regular multidisciplinary meetings and tumour streams with a leading tertiary cancer centre
  • Excellent work-life balance with no after-hours on-call
  • Supportive team culture focused on education and career progression
Research Opportunities
Be part of an award-winning clinical research unit actively involved in clinical trials and translational research. You'll be encouraged to:
  • Participate in clinical research projects
  • Present at oncology meetings
  • Publish and develop your academic portfolio
  • Work alongside experienced clinician researchers
The role also provides valuable experience delivering cancer care to rural and Indigenous communities, including exposure to innovative telehealth oncology services.
Spend less time commuting and more time doing what you enjoy, while remaining well connected to major metropolitan centres through regular flights.

Whether you're completing Advanced Training or looking to further your career as a Career Medical Officer or Senior Medical Practitioner, this is an opportunity to join a highly respected oncology service committed to clinical excellence, research and professional development.

How to Apply
 If you're ready to take the next step in your Medical Oncology career, we'd love to hear from you.

job.title: Staff Specialist Radiation Oncology
job.description:
Staff Specialist – Radiation Oncology
Deliver world-class cancer care while enjoying the lifestyle you've worked hard for.
Are you a Radiation Oncologist looking for a role where clinical excellence, collaboration and quality of life go hand in hand?

We're recruiting for a permanent Specialist opportunity within a highly respected tertiary Radiation Oncology service that delivers the full spectrum of contemporary cancer care. You'll join a collegial, forward-thinking team where your expertise is genuinely valued, your ideas are welcomed, and your contribution has a lasting impact on patients and the service.

More Than Just a Job
Imagine finishing work and being minutes from spectacular coastlines, mountain trails, award-winning restaurants and vibrant arts and cultural events. Enjoy short commutes, affordable living, excellent schools and a welcoming community that makes it easy to build a fulfilling life both professionally and personally.

If you're looking for a consultant role where you can practise high-quality medicine without sacrificing your lifestyle, we'd love to speak with you.
This is an exceptional opportunity to combine a rewarding consultant career with an enviable work-life balance, offering more time for family, outdoor pursuits and the things that matter most.

Why consider this opportunity?
  • Permanent consultant position with an attractive remuneration package of up to $450,000+
  • Work across a broad and diverse oncology case mix with modern technology and contemporary treatment techniques
  • Join a supportive multidisciplinary team committed to delivering outstanding patient-centred care

  • Dedicated professional development leave and generous CPD allowance

Interested?

job.title: Consultant/Specialist Interventional Cardiologist
job.description:
Consultant/Specialist Interventional Cardiologist
Tropical Coastal Queensland | Permanent Full-Time | Exceptional Career & Lifestyle – Excellent salary package up to $550k plus – MUST HAVE FRACP
Join one of regional Australia's most progressive cardiac services.

An outstanding opportunity exists for an experienced Interventional Cardiologist to become part of a modern, expanding cardiac service delivering comprehensive specialist care to a population of approximately 190,000.
Working alongside an experienced and collaborative team of five Cardiologists (four Interventional and one Non-Interventional), you'll enjoy a diverse clinical practice with access to contemporary technology, an accredited teaching environment and a genuine work-life balance.

Enjoy an Incredible Lifestyle
Outside of work you'll enjoy one of Australia's most desirable coastal regions, offering:
  • Warm tropical climate all year
  • Beautiful beaches and waterfront living
  • The Great Barrier Reef on your doorstep
  • Sailing, fishing, diving and boating
  • National parks and rainforest adventures
  • Excellent public and private schools
  • Affordable housing compared with metropolitan centres
  • Short commute times and genuine work-life balance
  • Direct flights to Brisbane, Sydney and Melbourne
Why join this Cardiology Service?
This is a busy regional referral centre providing a comprehensive range of diagnostic and interventional cardiac services, supported by excellent infrastructure and strong tertiary partnerships.

Comprehensive Interventional Cardiology
You'll have access to a fully equipped Cardiac Catheterisation Laboratory featuring:
  • Modern catheterisation suite with IVUS, OCT and Fractional Flow Reserve (FFR)
  • 24/7 Primary PCI service
  • Coronary angiography and coronary intervention
  • Permanent pacemaker implantation
  • Dedicated 8-bed Coronary Care Unit
Advanced Cardiac Imaging
The department offers an extensive range of non-invasive imaging including:
  • Transthoracic Echocardiography
  • 3D Transoesophageal Echocardiography (TOE)
  • Stress Echocardiography
  • Dobutamine Stress Echocardiography
  • CT Coronary Angiography (CTCA)
  • On-site Cardiac MRI
Additional services include Holter monitoring, ambulatory blood pressure monitoring, exercise stress testing and cardiac event recorders.

Strong Multidisciplinary Support
The service benefits from:
  • Weekly Heart Team meetings with cardiothoracic surgeons
  • Established Heart Failure and Medication Titration Service
  • Dedicated Chest Pain Short Stay Unit
  • Close collaboration with tertiary cardiac centres
  • Regular education through statewide ECG and Echocardiography forums
Teaching & Leadership
This is an excellent opportunity for cardiologists who enjoy teaching and mentoring.
The department is RACP accredited for Advanced Cardiology Training and currently supports:
  • Advanced Trainees
  • Principal House Officers
  • Junior Medical Officers
  • Interns
You'll play an important role in:
  • Clinical supervision and mentoring
  • Registrar and medical student education
  • Quality improvement initiatives
  • Clinical governance
  • Research and service development
  • Patient safety and audit activities
About You
We welcome applications from Cardiologists who are passionate about delivering outstanding patient care while contributing to teaching and the ongoing development of cardiac services.
To be considered for MUST HAVE -
  • FRACP Interventional Cardiologists
What You'll Receive
  • Permanent full-time consultant appointment
  • Competitive specialist remuneration package
  • Relocation assistance
  • Professional development support
  • Modern cardiac facilities and technology
  • Collegiate, supportive multidisciplinary team
  • Excellent career progression opportunities
  • Outstanding coastal lifestyle
How to Apply
If you're an FRACP-qualified Interventional Cardiologist looking to join a progressive regional cardiac service while enjoying an outstanding tropical coastal lifestyle, we'd love to hear from you.

For a confidential discussion or to request further information, please contact:

job.title: Emergency Medicine Registrars/Senior Registrar Australia-Wide Opportunities
job.description:
Emergency Medicine Registrars/Senior Registrar
Australia-Wide Opportunities | Coastal, Regional and Metropolitan Locations
Are you an Emergency Medicine Registrar considering your next career move?

CC Medical is recruiting experienced Emergency Medicine Registrars for a range of hospitals across Australia, offering the opportunity to combine excellent clinical experience with an outstanding lifestyle.
From vibrant capital cities and thriving regional centres to tropical destinations, coastal communities and scenic country locations, we have opportunities to suit a wide range of career and lifestyle preferences.

Choose the Lifestyle That Suits You

Coastal Living
Enjoy access to beautiful beaches, relaxed communities, outdoor dining and a healthier work-life balance. Many coastal locations offer excellent schools, short commutes and affordable housing compared with larger cities.
Spend your days off swimming, surfing, fishing, hiking or exploring some of Australia’s most spectacular coastline.

Tropical Destinations
Build your Emergency Medicine career while living close to rainforests, islands, national parks and the Great Barrier Reef.
Tropical locations provide a diverse and interesting patient population, excellent procedural exposure and opportunities to gain experience in trauma, retrieval medicine, critical care and tropical medicine.

Vibrant Regional Cities
Regional centres offer the perfect balance between career progression and lifestyle.

You can enjoy:
  • Affordable housing and a lower cost of living
  • Shorter commutes and less congestion
  • Excellent schools and family-friendly communities
  • Cafés, restaurants, sporting facilities and cultural events
  • Easy access to national parks, wineries, beaches and outdoor activities
  • Strong community connections and a relaxed pace of life
Regional Emergency Departments often provide broader clinical exposure, greater procedural opportunities and closer working relationships with senior consultants.

Metropolitan Opportunities
For doctors who prefer city living, opportunities may also be available in major metropolitan and outer-metropolitan hospitals.
These locations offer access to tertiary services, subspecialty rotations, teaching programs, universities, international airports and a wide range of entertainment, dining and cultural activities.

The Opportunities
Positions may include:
  • Emergency Medicine Registrar
  • Senior Emergency Medicine Registrar
  • Principal House Officer – Emergency Medicine
Hospitals may offer:
  • Accredited Emergency Medicine training
  • Dedicated consultant supervision
  • Exposure to trauma, paediatrics, critical care and retrieval medicine
  • Competitive salaries, penalties and superannuation
  • Flexible fixed-term and permanent contracts
  • Relocation assistance
  • Visa sponsorship for eligible international doctors
  • Professional development and career progression opportunities
We Are Looking For
Doctors with:
  • Current or eligible AHPRA registration
  • A minimum of 5 years postgraduate clinical experience
  • Previous Emergency Medicine experience
  • Strong communication and teamwork skills
  • A commitment to safe, high-quality patient care
Applications are welcomed from Australian-trained doctors, New Zealand graduates and experienced International Medical Graduates who are eligible for registration in Australia.

Make the Move
Whether you are looking for a coastal lifestyle, tropical adventure, affordable regional living or the opportunities of a major city, we can help you identify a location that suits your career, family and lifestyle goals.
CC Medical provides support with:
  • Position and location matching
  • Interview preparation
  • AHPRA registration
  • Visa and migration processes
  • Relocation planning
  • Ongoing support throughout your move
Contact CC Medical today for a confidential discussion about Emergency Medicine Registrar opportunities across Australia.
Nicki Wade
Senior Recruitment Consultant – Permanent Doctors
CC Medical

✉️ nickiw@ccjobs.com.au
